title: LooseControlVideo: Directorial Video Control using Spatial Blocking
summary: Precise 3D spatial orchestration in text-to-video generation remains a significant challenge, particularly for multi-object scenes where semantic layout and temporal dynamics are often entangled. While existing depth-conditioned models achieve good structural fidelity, they necessitate dense, frame-accurate guidance that is labor-intensive to author for dynamic events involving deformable objects. We present LooseControlVideo, a framework that enables intuitive and expressive control by using sparse, oriented 3D boxes as a "blocking" proxy. This allows users to author high-level layout and trajectory while leveraging a video generative model to generate realistic occlusions, dynamics and interactions. We achieve this by fine-tuning a Wan 2.2 backbone on a video dataset annotated with DNOCS, a novel encoding for 3D size, orientation and depth-ordered occlusions. Furthermore, our method allows for localized refinement, such as adjusting a jump trajectory or adding an interaction, with minimal disruption to the global scene context. Extensive evaluations on the nuScenes, HO-3D, and BEHAVE benchmarks demonstrate that LooseControlVideo significantly outperforms existing 2D-box and flow-based baselines. Our findings indicate a 1.2x to 3x improvement in Trajectory Error; 2x improvement in Rigid Motion Consistency; and a 1.5x to 2x increase in Occlusion Accuracy over current state-of-the-art layout-conditioned models, demonstrating that oriented 3D primitives provide good geometric prior for complex, multi-agent video authoring.

AI.tldr: LooseControlVideo 通过使用稀疏、带朝向的3D框作为“阻挡”代理，实现了对文本生成视频中多物体场景的高层布局与轨迹控制，在nuScenes、HO-3D、BEHAVE基准上显著优于现有方法，轨迹误差改善1.2-3倍，刚体运动一致性提升2倍，遮挡精度提高1.5-2倍。
AI.motivation: 现有深度条件模型需要逐帧精确的深度图，手工标注成本高，且难以处理可变形物体的动态事件；而2D框和光流方法缺乏对3D空间结构的精确控制。本文旨在实现一种直观、高效且表达力强的3D空间编排控制方法。
AI.method: 提出LooseControlVideo框架，使用稀疏的、带朝向的3D框作为高层布局与轨迹的“阻挡”代理；在Wan 2.2骨干网络上进行微调，并采用DNOCS编码（包含3D尺寸、朝向和深度顺序遮挡信息）；支持局部细化（如调整跳跃轨迹或添加交互），对全局场景影响最小。
AI.result: 在nuScenes、HO-3D、BEHAVE基准上，轨迹误差提升1.2-3倍，刚体运动一致性提升2倍，遮挡精度提升1.5-2倍，全面超越现有2D框和光流基线方法。
AI.conclusion: 带朝向的3D基元为复杂多智能体视频创作提供了良好的几何先验，能够有效解耦语义布局与时序动态，实现高质量的视频生成控制。

title: ImageWAM: Do World Action Models Really Need Video Generation, or Just Image Editing?
summary: World Action Models (WAMs) commonly rely on video generation to bridge visual world modeling and robot control. However, video-based WAMs face three coupled limitations: dense multi-frame future tokens make inference costly, full video prediction spends capacity on action-irrelevant temporal and appearance details, and long-horizon future imagination may introduce errors that mislead action prediction. These issues raise a simple question: Does world action model really need video generation? We propose ImageWAM, a simple WAM framework that repurposes pretrained image editing models for robot action prediction. In contrast to video generation, image editing provides a better-matched prior: it only needs to model a target-frame transformation, focuses on action-relevant current-to-target visual differences, and grounds task instructions to localized visual changes through edit pretraining. In practice, ImageWAM does not decode the target frame at inference time; instead, it conditions a flow-matching action expert on the KV caches produced by image-editing denoising, using them as a compact world-action context. ImageWAM outperforms standard VLA baselines and matching competitive WAMs without additional policy pretraining across different simulator and real-world experiments. It also reduces FLOPs to 1/6 and latency to 1/4 of video-based WAMs. Attention analysis further shows that editing caches focus on task-relevant change regions, supporting image editing as an effective alternative to video-based world-action modeling.

AI.tldr: ImageWAM提出用图像编辑替代视频生成来建模世界动作模型，在降低计算开销的同时提升机器人动作预测性能。
AI.motivation: 现有基于视频生成的WAM存在推理成本高、计算资源浪费于动作无关细节、长时预测误差累积等问题，作者质疑世界动作模型是否真的需要视频生成，并探索更高效的替代方案。
AI.method: 将预训练的图文编辑模型重新用于机器人动作预测。推理时不解码目标帧，而是用图像编辑去噪过程中产生的KV缓存作为"世界动作上下文"，输入给流匹配动作专家进行动作预测。
AI.result: 在多个仿真和真实实验中，ImageWAM超越标准VLA基线和竞品WAM，且FLOPs降低至1/6，延迟降至1/4。注意力分析显示编辑缓存聚焦于任务相关的变化区域。
AI.conclusion: 图像编辑可作为视频生成的有效替代方案，用于世界动作建模，兼顾效率与性能。

title: Exposing the Unsaid: Visualizing Hidden LLM Bias through Stochastic Path Aggregation
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) exhibit representational and syntactic biases that are difficult to evaluate due to the stochastic nature of text generation. Standard auditing methods rely on a single output inspection or static automated metrics. These approaches obscure the underlying probability distributions and fail to capture biases hidden in lower-probability generation branches. This paper introduces TreeTracer, a visual analytics tool designed to evaluate LLM bias through aggregated comparison. Using a systematic perturbation analysis pipeline, the tool replaces ontology-defined terms in each input prompt, aggregates hundreds of stochastic generations into a syntax-aligned hierarchical structure, and then performs classification-aware node merging with an auxiliary language model. The resulting structure is visualized through a custom Sankey diagram. By juxtaposing two ontology-driven trees, the workspace enables direct comparison between semantic contexts and supports systematic bias detection. Because any visualization reflects only a subset of the model's learned behavior, the system further applies contrastive inference to compute and directly display counterfactual token probabilities across contexts, reducing the risk of misinterpreting the presence of bias. We validate the workspace through case studies comparing an unaligned baseline model GPT-2 XL against the constitutionally aligned Apertus models. The visual aggregation successfully exposes hidden representational harms, such as counterfactual pronoun suppression and conversational marginalization of individuals. A preliminary user study confirms that the aggregated comparative interface reduces cognitive load and effectively supports analysts in detecting systemic biases.

AI.tldr: TreeTracer是一个通过可视化对比分析来检测LLM中隐藏偏见（如代词压制、对话边缘化）的工具，它利用扰动测试、语法对齐聚合和桑基图对比来降低分析者的认知负载。
AI.motivation: 标准审计方法依赖单次输出检查或静态自动指标，无法捕捉隐藏在下层概率生成分支中的偏见，也难以评估LLM的表征和句法偏见。
AI.method: 采用系统扰动分析流程：用本体定义的术语替换输入提示，聚合数百个随机生成为语法对齐的层次结构，通过辅助语言模型进行分类感知的节点合并，并通过自定义桑基图可视化。通过对比两个本体驱动的树结构，结合对比推断计算反事实标记概率。
AI.result: 在GPT-2 XL（未对齐基线模型）与Apertus（宪法对齐模型）的案例研究中，成功暴露了反事实代词压制和对话边缘化等隐藏的表征危害。
AI.conclusion: 聚合比较界面降低了认知负载，有效支持分析者检测系统性偏见。

title: Deontic Policies for Runtime Governance of Agentic AI Systems
comment: 10 pages, 1 figure. To be published in the 2026 IEEE Symposium on Agentic Services which is part of the IEEE Conference on Web Services
summary: Autonomous agentic AI systems driven by Large Language Models (LLMs) introduce a new class of security, privacy, and compliance challenges: an agent that can invoke tools, manipulate data, install software, and coordinate with peer agents across organizational boundaries must be constrained not just by authentication and access control, but by the full structure of enterprise governance. This includes specifying what agents are permitted and prohibited from doing, what they areobliged to do after certain actions (e.g., notify the CISO), under what conditions a standing obligation may be waived, and which rules take precedence when policies conflict. This governance problem exceeds what current policy engines provide. Systems such as XACML, Rego, and Cedar address only the permit/prohibit subset of this governance structure. They do not provide obligation lifecycle management, meta-policy conflict resolution, dispensations that waive obligations in specific circumstances, and ontological reasoning over domain class hierarchies commonly found in applications such as healthcare, cybersecurity, or data privacy. We propose AgenticRei, which realizes key governance requirements such as obligations, dispensations, policy conflict resolutions, and reasoning over policies, as well as the basic permit/prohibit constraints. We use a deontic policy language built on the Rei framework, expressed as OWL (Web Ontology Language) and evaluated at runtime by a high-performance logic engine entirely outside the LLM. The same pipeline governs both tool invocations by the agent and agent-to-agent messages. We show through examples that deontic policies capture governance constraints around security and privacy that mostly cannot be expressed in current production engines. Our approach composes naturally with industry-standard frameworks like A2AS.

AI.tldr: 本文提出AgenticRei，一个基于道义策略框架的治理系统，用于解决LLM驱动的自主AI代理在安全、隐私和合规方面的治理问题，涵盖许可/禁止、义务、豁免、策略冲突解决和本体推理等能力，超越了XACML、Rego、Cedar等现有策略引擎的功能范围。
AI.motivation: LLM驱动的自主AI代理能够调用工具、操作数据、安装软件并与跨组织的代理协同，这带来了新的安全、隐私和合规挑战。现有策略引擎（如XACML、Rego、Cedar）仅涵盖许可/禁止子集，缺乏义务生命周期管理、元策略冲突解决、豁免机制以及领域本体推理能力，无法满足企业级治理需求。
AI.method: 基于Rei框架的道义策略语言，使用OWL（Web本体语言）表达策略，在LLM外部由高性能逻辑引擎在运行时进行评估。该管道同时治理代理的工具调用和代理间消息。与A2AS等行业标准框架自然兼容。
AI.result: 通过实例证明，道义策略能够捕获围绕安全和隐私的治理约束，而这些约束大部分无法在当前生产的策略引擎中表达。AgenticRei实现了义务管理、豁免、策略冲突解决以及基本许可/禁止约束等关键治理需求。
AI.conclusion: AgenticRei为自主AI代理提供了超越现有策略引擎的完整企业级治理方案，能够处理复杂的义务、豁免和冲突解决场景，并可与行业标准框架组合使用。

title: PerceptionDLM: Parallel Region Perception with Multimodal Diffusion Language Models
summary: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have achieved remarkable progress in visual understanding tasks. However, most existing MLLMs rely on autoregressive generation, which limits their efficiency for perception tasks that require captioning multiple regions. In this work, we propose PerceptionDLM, a multimodal diffusion language model optimized for efficient parallel region perception. Built upon PerceptionDLM-Base, a strong foundational baseline that achieves state-of-the-art performance among open-source diffusion MLLMs, our architecture fully leverages the parallel decoding nature of DLMs. Specifically, we introduce efficient prompting and structured attention masking to enable simultaneous perception of multiple masked regions, allowing the model to generate region descriptions in parallel at both the sequence and token levels. This design significantly improves inference efficiency compared with existing approaches that process regions sequentially. To systematically evaluate the parallelism property of visual perception capability for DLMs, we construct a new Parallel Detailed Localized Captioning Benchmark (ParaDLC-Bench) by scaling the DLC-Bench to include multiple region masks per image, enabling joint evaluation of both caption quality and inference efficiency. Experiments demonstrate that PerceptionDLM maintains competitive performance in region captioning while achieving substantial speed improvements for multi-region perception tasks. Our results highlight the potential of multimodal diffusion language models for efficient, parallel visual perception. To the best of our knowledge, we are the first to achieve parallel region caption and perception by leveraging the advantages of diffusion language models. Code, models, and datasets are released.

AI.tldr: 本文提出PerceptionDLM，一种多模态扩散语言模型，通过并行解码实现对多个图像区域的高效感知，构建了ParaDLC-Bench基准，在保持区域描述质量的同时大幅提升了多区域感知的推理速度。
AI.motivation: 现有MLLMs多采用自回归生成方式，处理多区域描述时需要逐个区域顺序解码，推理效率低下。本文旨在利用扩散语言模型（DLMs）的并行解码特性，实现高效的并行区域感知。
AI.method: 基于PerceptionDLM-Base基线架构，引入高效提示（efficient prompting）和结构化注意力掩码（structured attention masking），使模型在序列级和token级同时生成多个掩码区域的描述，充分利用DLM的并行解码能力。同时构建ParaDLC-Bench基准，扩展DLC-Bench以包含每张图像的多个区域掩码。
AI.result: PerceptionDLM在区域描述任务上保持了有竞争力的性能，同时在多区域感知任务中实现了显著的速度提升。在开源扩散MLLMs中达到了最先进水平。
AI.conclusion: 多模态扩散语言模型在高效并行视觉感知方面具有巨大潜力，本文首次实现了利用扩散语言模型的优势完成并行区域描述和感知。

title: Measuring Curriculum Alignment across Topical Coverage, Competency, and Cognitive Depth: A Longitudinal Framework Applied to CS2013 and CS2023
summary: Undergraduate computer science is governed by international curricular guidelines revised about once a decade, yet programs lack a reliable, reproducible way to measure how completely they cover the current guidelines and how that coverage shifts when the guidelines are restructured. We address this with a human-in-the-loop pipeline that measures a program's coverage of an external body of knowledge, applied longitudinally to one accredited BSc in Computer Science against Computer Science Curricula 2013 (CS2013) and 2023 (CS2023). The pipeline represents the program and each guideline as structured corpora, generates candidate course-to-knowledge-unit matches by semantic retrieval, and confirms them through human judgment under an explicit coverage definition. Of seven benchmarked retrievers, a reciprocal-rank-fusion ensemble was strongest, and a reputed long-context model underperformed a small sentence model, so retriever choice must be measured. Both maps were validated by an independent second rater (Cohen's kappa 0.64 for CS2023, 0.69 for CS2013). The program covers 49.7% of CS2023 and 50.9% of CS2013 knowledge units, near-constant across a decade. Extending the same retrieve-then-confirm design to competency articulation and cognitive depth shows that the program articulates the competency for ~88% of covered units under each guideline, yet delivers it at the recommended depth for 76% of present units under CS2023 against 95% under CS2013, a gap reflecting the newer guideline's raised expectations, not the program. The longitudinal comparison separates persistent structural gaps (parallel and distributed computing, foundations of programming languages, systems fundamentals), uncovered against both guidelines and ABET, from differences that reflect the standard's evolution. The instrument is reusable and available from the authors on request.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个人类参与的人机协作流程，用于衡量计算机科学本科项目对国际课程指南（CS2013与CS2023）的覆盖程度。通过语义检索与人工确认相结合的方法，对某认证项目进行纵向分析，发现该项目对两份指南的知识单元覆盖率基本持平（约50%），但在认知深度上CS2023的要求显著提升。研究还区分了持久性结构缺陷与指南演化带来的差异。
AI.motivation: 计算机科学本科课程虽有国际指南，但缺乏可靠、可重复的方法来量化项目对指南的覆盖程度，以及指南更新时覆盖度的变化情况。
AI.method: 采用人机协作流程：将项目课程和指南分别构建为结构化语料库，通过语义检索生成候选匹配，再由人工根据明确定义确认匹配。测试了7种检索器，最终采用倒数排序融合集成方法，并由独立评估者验证。
AI.result: 项目覆盖CS2023的49.7%和CS2013的50.9%，覆盖率十年间基本不变。在能力表述方面，两份指南均约88%的覆盖单元有对应，但在认知深度上，CS2023仅76%达标，CS2013为95%。发现并行与分布式计算、编程语言基础、系统基础等持久性结构缺陷。
AI.conclusion: 该流程可复用，能区分课程自身的结构性不足与指南标准演化带来的差异，为课程评估和改进提供可靠工具。

title: Mix-QVLA: Task-Evidence-Aware Mixed-Precision Quantization of Vision-Language-Action Models
summary: We propose Mix-QVLA, a task-evidence-aware mixed-precision PTQ framework for VLA models. Mix-QVLA anchors each quantized variant to the full-precision action-token reference decision and evaluates whether quantization preserves task-relevant evidence across key VLA functional boundaries. It computes normalized gradient-weighted task-evidence maps from boundary activations and compares full-precision and quantized maps using evidence-mass and attribution-distribution distortion, capturing changes in both the strength and allocation of decision-supporting evidence. A soft-bottleneck objective aggregates boundary-level degradation into layer-wise sensitivity scores. Mix-QVLA further models sensitivity throughout task execution, capturing phase-dependent shifts in layer importance rather than assuming a fixed sensitivity profile. The resulting evidence- and time-aware scores guide mixed-precision bit allocation under model-size and BitOps budgets. Extensive evaluations on OpenVLA-style policies show that Mix-QVLA improves the accuracy-efficiency trade-off of low-bit VLA deployment. On LIBERO, Mix-QVLA reduces OpenVLA-OFT memory from 15.4 GB to 4.1 GB, retains 96.3 average success compared with 97.1 for the BF16 model, and achieves a 1.52x inference speedup.

AI.tldr: Mix-QVLA提出了一种任务证据感知的混合精度PTQ框架，通过梯度加权任务证据图评估量化对VLA模型决策的影响，实现低比特部署下的精度-效率平衡。
AI.motivation: 现有的VLA模型量化方法未考虑量化对任务相关决策证据的影响，缺乏对模型不同功能边界处证据保留情况的评估机制。
AI.method: 1) 以全精度动作token参考决策为锚点，计算梯度加权的任务证据图；2) 通过证据质量和归因分布失真度量全精度与量化图的差异；3) 使用软瓶颈目标聚合边界级退化为层敏感度分数；4) 建模任务执行过程中的时间依赖敏感度变化；5) 基于证据和时间感知分数指导混合精度比特分配。
AI.result: 在OpenVLA策略上，LIBERO任务中将OpenVLA-OFT内存从15.4GB降至4.1GB，保留96.3%平均成功率（BF16为97.1%），实现1.52倍推理加速。
AI.conclusion: Mix-QVLA有效改善了低比特VLA部署的精度-效率权衡，证明了任务证据感知的量化策略在保持决策质量的同时显著降低资源消耗的可行性。

title: Disentangling Linguistic Relatedness from Task Alignment in Cross-Lingual Transfer
summary: We study cross-lingual transfer by fine-tuning seven large language models (4B--671B parameters) on Arabic and evaluating zero-shot reading comprehension on Semitic languages and non-Semitic controls. Across dense and Mixture-of-Experts architectures, we find no evidence of Semitic-specific transfer: models with weak baselines improve dramatically across all languages, while strong-baseline models show only marginal gains regardless of language family. A chain-of-thought ablation reinforces this finding -- the same models that benefit most from fine-tuning benefit equally from inference-time reasoning, suggesting both mechanisms address task-format alignment rather than cross-lingual knowledge transfer.

AI.tldr: 通过微调7个大语言模型（4B-671B参数）在阿拉伯语上，评估零样本跨语言阅读理解，发现不存在闪米特语族特有的迁移效应，模型性能提升主要源于任务格式对齐而非跨语言知识迁移。
AI.motivation: 探究大语言模型在跨语言迁移中是否存在语言族系（闪米特语族）特有的知识迁移能力，还是仅仅通过任务格式对齐获得提升。
AI.method: 微调7个大语言模型（规模4B-671B，涵盖密集架构和混合专家架构）在阿拉伯语上，然后在闪米特语族和非闪米特语族控制组语言上评估零样本阅读理解。同时进行了思维链消融实验。
AI.result: 未发现闪米特语族特有的迁移效应：弱基线模型在所有语言上均大幅提升，强基线模型仅获得边际提升。思维链消融实验进一步证实，同一模型从微调和推理时推理中获益程度相当，说明两者均作用于任务格式对齐。
AI.conclusion: 跨语言迁移中的性能提升主要来自于任务格式对齐（适应阅读理解的格式要求），而非真正的跨语言知识迁移。

title: Diffusion Language Models: An Experimental Analysis
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) have revolutionized language modeling through autoregressive generation, enabling strong performance across a wide range of tasks. Recently, Diffusion Language Models (DLMs) have emerged as an alternative paradigm that generates text through iterative denoising rather than next-token prediction, allowing parallel refinement of entire sequences. While numerous diffusion-based architectures have been proposed, differences in evaluation protocols, datasets, inference budgets, and generation hyperparameters make it difficult to compare their capabilities and understand the trade-offs they offer. In this work, we present a systematic experimental analysis of modern DLMs. Specifically, we evaluate eight state-of-the-art DLMs across eight benchmarks spanning reasoning, coding, translation, knowledge, and structured problem solving, while explicitly considering both generation quality and computational efficiency. Beyond downstream evaluation, we analyze the impact of key inference-time factors, including denoising steps, context length, block size, and parallel unmasking strategies, and complement large-scale experiments with controlled comparisons of smaller models trained under identical conditions. Our analysis highlights the strengths and limitations of diffusion-based language modeling across different tasks, architectures, and inference budgets. We show that the behavior of DLMs is strongly influenced by generation-time design choices, leading to distinct trade-offs between performance and computational efficiency. Overall, our study provides practical insights into the capabilities and deployment characteristics of contemporary DLMs.

AI.tldr: 本文系统分析了8种现代扩散语言模型在8个基准上的表现，涵盖推理、编码、翻译、知识问答和结构化问题求解等任务，揭示了扩散模型在生成质量与计算效率之间的权衡，并探讨了去噪步数、上下文长度、块大小等推理参数的影响。
AI.motivation: 由于现有扩散语言模型在评估协议、数据集、推理预算和生成超参数上存在差异，导致难以公平比较各模型的能力与权衡，因此需要系统性的实验分析来提供统一视角。
AI.method: 选取8种SOTA扩散语言模型，在8个覆盖推理、编码、翻译等任务的基准上进行评估；同时控制训练条件进行小规模对比实验，分析去噪步数、上下文长度、块大小和并行解掩策略等推理因素的影响。
AI.result: 扩散语言模型的行为受生成时设计选择强烈影响，不同任务、架构和推理预算下表现出差异化的性能-效率权衡。
AI.conclusion: 研究为当代扩散语言模型的能力和部署特性提供了实用见解，强调了生成时间设计选择对模型表现的关键作用。

title: Language-Instructed Vision Embeddings for Controllable and Generalizable Perception
summary: Vision foundation models are typically trained as static feature extractors, placing the burden of task adaptation onto large downstream models. We propose an alternative paradigm: instead of solely feeding visual features into language models, we use language itself to dynamically guide the vision encoder. Our method, Language-Instructed Vision Embeddings (LIVE), leverages language as high-level guidance to produce task-centric embeddings at inference time, removing the need for task-specific retraining. This enables the encoder to focus on contextually relevant aspects of the input, yielding more controllable and generalizable representations. Empirically, LIVE reduces visual hallucinations (+34 points on MMVP), surpasses vision-language models with orders of magnitude more parameters on visual question answering, and generalizes to unseen instructions and tasks -- offering a direct path toward adaptive, instruction-driven visual intelligence.

AI.tldr: 本文提出LIVE方法，利用语言指令动态引导视觉编码器生成任务导向的嵌入表示，无需任务特定重训练，在减少视觉幻觉、提升VQA性能等方面取得显著成果。
AI.motivation: 传统视觉基础模型作为静态特征提取器，任务适应依赖于大型下游模型，缺乏灵活性和可控制性。
AI.method: 提出Language-Instructed Vision Embeddings (LIVE)，在推理时使用语言作为高层指导动态调节视觉编码器，生成任务中心的嵌入表示。
AI.result: 在MMVP上减少视觉幻觉34个百分点，在视觉问答任务上超越参数多数量级的视觉语言模型，并泛化到未见指令和任务。
AI.conclusion: LIVE提供了一种自适应、指令驱动的视觉智能新范式，实现了更可控和可泛化的视觉表示。

title: How LLMs Fail and Generalize in RTL Coding for Hardware Design?
summary: Translating sequential programming priors into the parallel temporal logic of hardware design remains a crucial bottleneck for large language models(LLM). To investigate this, we introduce a new error taxonomy grounded in problem solvability, inspired by cognitive theory. Our taxonomy categorizes failures into syntactic, semantic, solvable functional, and unsolvable functional types. Evaluations reveal a strict empirical ceiling on the VerilogEval benchmark, as frontier models plateau at a 90.8% initial pass rate. These plateaus are defined by unsolvable functional errors, exposing persistent knowledge gaps immune to test time compute scaling. Furthermore, we expose a striking surface convergence gap: optimization readily eliminates syntax errors but concurrently exacerbates deeper functional failures. Our findings demonstrate that alignment techniques merely teach models to compile. While repeated sampling strategies can patch solvable errors, register-transfer level(RTL) coding capacity remains strictly bounded by pretraining knowledge. Addressing challenges in the current LLM based hardware generation pipeline requires more studies in model reasoning rather than alignment interventions.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了LLM在硬件设计中的局限性，发现即使最先进的模型在VerilogEval基准上也仅有90.8%的初始通过率，且存在无法通过计算扩展解决的不可解功能性错误，揭示了对齐技术仅能教会模型编译而非真正理解RTL编码。
AI.motivation: 将顺序编程先验知识转化为硬件设计的并行时序逻辑仍是LLM的重要瓶颈，现有方法缺乏系统性的错误分类和对模型能力上限的深入分析。
AI.method: 提出基于问题可解性的错误分类法，将失败分为语法错误、语义错误、可解功能错误和不可解功能错误四类，并在VerilogEval基准上评估前沿模型的表现。
AI.result: 前沿模型在VerilogEval上达到90.8%的初始通过率后陷入停滞；优化可消除语法错误但会加剧深层功能错误；重复采样能修复可解错误但无法突破预训练知识边界。
AI.conclusion: 当前对齐技术只能让模型学会编译，RTL编码能力受限于预训练知识；未来应更多关注模型推理能力的提升而非对齐干预。

title: Hidden Anchors in Multi-Agent LLM Deliberation
summary: Multi-agent LLM deliberation, where agents exchange and revise answers over several rounds, is increasingly used to improve reasoning and accuracy, yet how and why it works is rarely modelled. Such deliberation mirrors how humans reach decisions. As social animals we are pulled both by the group, the herd effect that classical opinion-dynamics models such as DeGroot and Friedkin--Johnsen capture, and by our own internal belief, which they do not. We model multi-agent deliberation as a closed-loop dynamical system in which each agent carries a hidden internal belief, its anchor, that continually pulls its opinion regardless of its neighbours. We show this anchor can be recovered from the deliberation alone, and that it explains a behaviour classical consensus rules forbid: an agent's confidence in the correct answer can climb past where any agent started, escaping the space (convexhull) formed by the initial beliefs. Checking whether the recovered anchor also predicts held-out runs (generalizes) gives a simple test for when a model is truly driven bysuch an anchor. Across three open-weight model families this is a spectrum, not all-or-nothing. All anchors' influence are about equally strongly, but they differ in where the anchor sits, and only when it sits far from the initial opinions does deliberation escape the hull and need the full closed-loop model.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个封闭循环动力学模型，将多智能体LLM协商过程建模为每个智能体既受邻居影响又受内部隐藏信念（锚点）拉动的过程。该模型可以解释经典共识规则无法解释的现象：智能体对正确答案的置信度可能超越任何初始信念的凸包。通过恢复锚点并检验其泛化能力，可以判断模型的驱动力来源。实验表明，不同模型家族的锚点影响程度相似，但锚点位置不同，只有当锚点远离初始观点时，协商才能突破凸包。
AI.motivation: 多智能体LLM协商虽然被广泛用于提升推理能力，但其工作机制缺乏理论建模。受人类群体决策中群体效应与个人信念双重作用的启发，作者希望建立数学模型来解释和预测多智能体协商中的动态行为。
AI.method: 将多智能体协商建模为封闭循环动力学系统，每个智能体携带一个隐藏的内部信念（锚点），该锚点持续拉拽其观点。通过协商过程可恢复锚点，并检验其能否预测未见过的协商轮次（泛化能力）。在三个开源模型家族上进行了实验验证。
AI.result: 锚点可以从协商过程中恢复，并能解释智能体置信度超越初始信念凸包的现象。不同模型家族的锚点影响强度相似，但锚点位置差异显著。只有当锚点远离初始观点时，协商才会突破凸包。
AI.conclusion: 多智能体协商中的锚点信念是一个谱系化的特征，而非全有或全无。锚点位置决定了协商行为是否突破初始信念空间，这为理解和设计更好的多智能体协商系统提供了理论基础。

title: GB-LSR: A Fast Local Spectral Image Representation with a Single Global Bandwidth for Continuous Reconstruction and Super-Resolution
summary: We present GB-LSR (Global-Bandwidth Local Spectral Representation), a fixed-grid local spectral representation for continuous image reconstruction. The image domain is partitioned into non-overlapping square patches, each carrying coefficients for a truncated Fourier basis predicted from shared convolutional-encoder features. A single trainable scalar bandwidth is shared globally across all patches and images, and reconstruction at any continuous coordinate is a fixed-size basis contraction whose cost is independent of image size. We study three bandwidth-handling variants: a trainable global scalar (main), a fixed global scalar, and a per-patch bandwidth field. On a standardized native-reconstruction benchmark across Kodak, Set14, and Urban100, the main variant outperforms matched-budget amortized LIIF / LTE / WIRE re-implementations by 2.8-3.6 dB PSNR and 0.11-0.15 LPIPS, while running at roughly one-quarter of the slowest baseline's inference cost. The single global scalar suffices empirically: per-patch adaptive-bandwidth alternatives do not improve over it on either a closed-form locality diagnostic or an end-to-end ablation. In a separate arbitrary-scale super-resolution (ASR) extension, GB-LSR achieves competitive PSNR-Y under a canonical-style SR protocol and runs 1.44x faster than LIIF-RDN and 3.25x faster than LTE-SwinIR at x4; within the same extension, a variant trained and evaluated without 4-corner local-ensemble averaging gives a 1.77x speedup with 35% lower peak memory and negligible PSNR change, while additionally widening the RDN encoder from 64 to 96 channels gives a small positive PSNR shift with a 1.58x speedup and 31% lower peak memory. Native-reconstruction claims are scoped to the matched-budget amortized protocol, and ASR claims are scoped to a separate canonical-style SR protocol.

AI.tldr: 本文提出GB-LSR，一种基于全局带宽的局部频谱图像重建方法，将图像划分为非重叠方块，每个方块承载截断傅里叶基系数，通过共享卷积编码器特征预测。单一可训练全局标量带宽在所有图像块间共享，重建成本与图像尺寸无关。在标准基准上，主变体以约四分之一的最低基线推理成本，超越LIIF/LTE/WIRE 2.8-3.6 dB PSNR和0.11-0.15 LPIPS。在任意尺度超分辨率任务中，GB-LSR在保持竞争力的同时实现显著加速。
AI.motivation: 针对连续图像重建中现有局部谱表示方法（如LIIF、LTE、WIRE）推理成本高、带宽处理复杂的问题，提出一种固定网格、全局带宽共享的高效局部频谱表示方法，旨在以更低计算成本实现更优或相当的重建质量。
AI.method: 将图像域划分为非重叠方形块，每个块携带由共享卷积编码器特征预测的截断傅里叶基系数。全局可训练标量带宽在所有块和图像间共享，连续坐标上的重建通过固定大小的基收缩实现。研究了三种带宽变体：可训练全局标量、固定全局标量、逐块带宽场。
AI.result: 在Kodak/Set14/Urban100基准上，主变体PSNR提升2.8-3.6 dB，LPIPS降低0.11-0.15，推理成本约为最慢基线四分之一。在任意尺度超分任务中，比LIIF-RDN快1.44倍，比LTE-SwinIR快3.25倍（x4）。去除四角局部集成平均的变体实现1.77倍加速和35%更低峰值内存，PSNR几乎不变。
AI.conclusion: 全局单一标量带宽在经验上足够，逐块自适应带宽并未带来改进。GB-LSR在原生重建和任意尺度超分任务中均展现了效率与性能的优越组合。

title: DeepSeek-V4: Towards Highly Efficient Million-Token Context Intelligence
summary: We present a preview version of DeepSeek-V4 series, including two strong Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) language models -- DeepSeek-V4-Pro with 1.6T parameters (49B activated) and DeepSeek-V4-Flash with 284B parameters (13B activated) -- both supporting a context length of one million tokens. DeepSeek-V4 series incorporate several key upgrades in architecture and optimization: (1) a hybrid attention architecture that combines Compressed Sparse Attention (CSA) and Heavily Compressed Attention (HCA) to improve long-context efficiency; (2) Manifold-Constrained Hyper-Connections (mHC) that enhance conventional residual connections; (3) and the Muon optimizer for faster convergence and greater training stability. We pre-train both models on more than 32T diverse and high-quality tokens, followed by a comprehensive post-training pipeline that unlocks and further enhances their capabilities. DeepSeek-V4-Pro-Max, the maximum reasoning effort mode of DeepSeek-V4-Pro, redefines the state-of-the-art for open models, outperforming its predecessors in core tasks. Meanwhile, DeepSeek-V4 series are highly efficient in long-context scenarios. In the one-million-token context setting, DeepSeek-V4-Pro requires only 27% of single-token inference FLOPs and 10% of KV cache compared with DeepSeek-V3.2. This enables us to routinely support one-million-token contexts, thereby making long-horizon tasks and further test-time scaling more feasible. The model checkpoints are available at https://huggingface.co/collections/deepseek-ai/deepseek-v4.

AI.tldr: DeepSeek-V4系列包含Pro（1.6T参数，49B激活）和Flash（284B参数，13B激活）两个MoE模型，支持百万token上下文。通过混合注意力架构（CSA+HCA）、流形约束超连接（mHC）和Muon优化器实现高效长上下文推理。Pro-Max模式在核心任务上达到开源SOTA，百万token下推理FLOPs仅需V3.2的27%，KV缓存仅10%。
AI.motivation: 现有大模型在处理超长上下文时面临推理效率低和KV缓存开销大的瓶颈，亟需在保持性能的同时降低计算成本，使百万token级的长上下文任务和测试时扩展更可行。
AI.method: （1）混合注意力架构：Compressed Sparse Attention (CSA) + Heavily Compressed Attention (HCA)；（2）Manifold-Constrained Hyper-Connections (mHC) 增强残差连接；（3）Muon优化器提升收敛速度和训练稳定性。在32T tokens上预训练，后进行全面的后训练流程。
AI.result: DeepSeek-V4-Pro-Max在核心任务上达到开源模型SOTA。在百万token上下文场景下，单token推理FLOPs仅为V3.2的27%，KV缓存仅需10%。
AI.conclusion: DeepSeek-V4系列在长上下文场景中实现了显著的效率提升，使得常规支持百万token上下文成为可能，推动了长程任务和测试时扩展的发展。

title: DeXposure-Claw: An Agentic System for DeFi Risk Supervision
summary: Decentralized finance exposes supervisors to fast-moving, networked credit risks. General-purpose LLM agents fit this setting poorly: they over-read weak evidence and recommend high-stakes interventions, while existing evaluations offer no regulator-aligned way to measure the resulting false alarms. We introduce DeXposure-Claw, a forecast-grounded agentic supervision system that routes LLM decisions through structured evidence: (1) DeXposure-FM, a graph time-series foundation model, forecasts future exposure networks; (2) deterministic monitors and stress scenarios then turn those forecasts into typed alerts, attribution signals, and scenario evidence; and (3) data-health and confidence gates constrain escalation before DeXposure-Claw emits auditable supervisory tickets with rationales. We further develop DeXposure-Bench, a six-axis evaluation harness, whose decision axis scores tickets against a regulator-aligned absolute-loss ground truth and an explicit false-intervention rate. Experiments on five years of weekly real data fully support our system. Code is at https://github.com/EVIEHub/DeXposure-Claw.

AI.tldr: 提出DeXposure-Claw，一个基于预测的监管代理系统，用于去中心化金融中的信用风险监管，通过图时间序列模型预测、确定性监控和置信度门控来减少LLM的误报干预。
AI.motivation: 去中心化金融（DeFi）中存在快速变化的网络化信用风险，而通用LLM代理容易过度解读弱证据并推荐高风险干预措施，现有评估缺乏符合监管标准的误报衡量方法。
AI.method: (1) DeXposure-FM图时间序列基础模型预测未来暴露网络；(2) 确定性监控器和压力场景将预测转化为类型化警报、归因信号和场景证据；(3) 数据健康与置信度门控约束升级流程，最终生成可审计的监管工单。
AI.result: 在五年周度真实数据上进行了实验验证。
AI.conclusion: 系统有效支持了监管场景，代码已开源。

title: Learning When to Denoise: Optimizing Asynchronous Schedules for Latent Diffusion
summary: Multi-representation diffusion models can improve visual synthesis by denoising complementary views of an image, but their performance depends critically on the asynchronous schedule that determines when each representation is denoised. We propose to learn this schedule. Our method formulates asynchronous flow matching over multiple representation spaces and uses a schedule-corrected objective that keeps each representation's local noising-time weights fixed as the schedule changes. We instantiate the schedule with a flexible parametric class that is convex and monotone by construction, and learn it using a fast joint probe with less than 1% additional training compute. On ImageNet 256x256, the learned schedule substantially improves both convergence speed and final quality under a matched 675M-parameter XL backbone. With AutoGuidance, our 200-epoch model reaches FID 1.05, matching the 800-epoch SFD-XL baseline with 4x less training. Training to 600 epochs further improves to FID 1.02, outperforming the 1B-parameter SFD-XXL result of FID 1.04 while using a smaller model. In the unguided setting, our 200-epoch model reaches FID 2.37, already below the best 800-epoch SFD-XL result (2.54) at 4x less training, and improves to FID 2.14 at 600 epochs. Code is available at https://github.com/bsq532087/LWD

AI.tldr: 本文提出学习多表示扩散模型中的异步调度策略，通过可学习的调度参数和调度修正目标函数，在ImageNet 256x256上实现了4倍训练加速，并取得了优于更大模型的FID分数。
AI.motivation: 多表示扩散模型的性能依赖于关键的异步调度（决定每个表示何时去噪），但现有方法中该调度是固定的，缺乏自适应性，作者希望学习这一调度以提升性能。
AI.method: 提出异步流匹配框架，设计调度修正目标函数（保持局部噪声时间权重固定），使用凸且单调的灵活参数化调度类，通过快速联合探针学习调度（额外训练计算<1%）。
AI.result: ImageNet 256x256上，200 epoch模型（AutoGuidance）FID 1.05，匹配800 epoch SFD-XL（4倍加速）；600 epoch FID 1.02，超越1B参数SFD-XXL的1.04。无引导下200 epoch FID 2.37，优于800 epoch SFD-XL的2.54。
AI.conclusion: 可学习的异步调度能显著提升多表示扩散模型的收敛速度和最终质量，在更小模型和更少训练量下达到更优性能。

title: Where to Place the Query? Unveiling and Mitigating Positional Bias in In-Context Learning for Diffusion LLMs via Decoding Dynamics
summary: While In-Context Learning (ICL) is extensively studied in Autoregressive (AR) LLMs, its mechanism within Diffusion Large Language Models (dLLMs) remains largely unexplored. Unlike AR models restricted by unidirectional causal masking, dLLMs intrinsically utilize bidirectional attention, offering extensive spatial flexibility for query placement. Unfortunately, current practices conventionally inherit AR-style trailing-query templates, often overlooking the structural paradigm shift. This paper presents a comprehensive analysis unveiling that query position is actually a first-order variable in dLLMs. Through empirical decoupling, we demonstrate that positional variance impacts generation quality on par with example semantic quality. Internally, this positional sensitivity stems from a spatial ``Recency Effect'' in attention flow and task-dependent shifts in decoding trajectories. To mitigate this instability without ground-truth labels, we reveal that traditional single-step confidence ($C_{decoded}$) fails in dLLMs. Instead, we propose Average Confidence ($\overline{C}$), a novel metric tracking the iterative decoding process. By establishing the foundational spatial ICL baselines, we introduce Auto-ICL, a training-free adaptive routing strategy that dynamically optimizes query placement, robustly approaching oracle performance across heterogeneous reasoning and perception tasks.

AI.tldr: 本文揭示了查询位置是扩散大语言模型(dLLM)中上下文学习(ICL)的一阶变量，并提出无需训练的Auto-ICL自适应路由策略来动态优化查询位置，在异构推理与感知任务中稳健逼近最优性能。
AI.motivation: 自回归LLM中ICL已被广泛研究，但扩散LLM中的ICL机制尚未被探索。当前实践沿用了自回归风格的尾查询模板，忽视了dLLM双向注意力的结构范式转变。
AI.method: 通过经验解耦分析位置影响，提出平均置信度指标追踪迭代解码过程，并设计Auto-ICL（无训练自适应路由策略）动态优化查询放置位置。
AI.result: 位置方差对生成质量的影响与示例语义质量相当；dLLM中存在空间"近因效应"；传统单步置信度在dLLM中失效，而平均置信度有效；Auto-ICL稳健逼近最优性能。
AI.conclusion: 查询位置是dLLM中ICL的一阶关键变量，Auto-ICL无需标注即可有效提升dLLM在各类任务上的ICL稳定性与性能。

title: TeleMorpher: Toward Robust Simultaneous Motion-Location Editing
summary: Diffusion models have achieved remarkable success in image and video generation and editing. While recent studies have extended these efforts toward motion editing, simultaneously transforming both motion and location-despite its practical importance-remains largely unexplored. To better understand robust motion-location editing, we first analyze the fundamental factors that degrade its quality. Based on this analysis, we propose TeleMorpher, one of the first one-shot frameworks to the best of our knowledge, for simultaneous motion-location editing. Our approach leverages motion priors, a target motion-centric video generated from an off-the-shelf model as motion-editing guidance, and the ground truth motion to enable more controllable and precise motion-location editing. Via this, our framework works as follows: (1) we first disentangle the protagonist and the background via pre-trained segmentation and inpainting models. (2) Then, we introduce a training-free pose warping that edits the protagonist's motion with the motion prior as the guidance. (3) The result of warped motion video is directly injected into a baseline motion editor during inference, mitigating the difference between source and target motions while preserving the appearance of the source video. (4) To enhance the reliability of quantitative evaluations, we propose two new LPIPS-based metrics that measure the background consistency before and after the motion editing and the fidelity of motion editing performance via measuring the difference between the extracted protagonist's skeletons from source and target videos. Experiments with in-the-wild videos and the TaiChi dataset demonstrate that TeleMorpher achieves superior performance across both quantitative and qualitative measurements (real-human evaluation), underscoring its effectiveness.

AI.tldr: 提出TeleMorpher框架，首次实现单样本同时编辑视频中的运动与位置，通过解耦主角与背景、无训练姿态扭曲和运动先验注入，在运动编辑任务上取得优异效果。
AI.motivation: 现有扩散模型在图像/视频生成和编辑上表现优异，但同时编辑运动与位置这一具有实际重要性的任务尚未被充分探索。
AI.method: (1)利用预训练分割和修复模型解耦主角与背景；(2)引入无训练的姿态扭曲，以运动先验为指导编辑主角运动；(3)将扭曲后的运动视频直接注入基线运动编辑器，减少源与目标运动差异同时保留外观；(4)提出两个基于LPIPS的新指标用于定量评估。
AI.result: 在野外视频和TaiChi数据集上，定性和定量（含真人评估）实验均表明TeleMorpher性能优于现有方法。
AI.conclusion: TeleMorpher是首个实现单样本同时编辑运动与位置的有效框架，提出的新评估指标也增强了定量评估的可靠性。

title: Pruning via Causal Attribution Preserves Reasoning Performance in Large Language Models
comment: Accepted at the ICLR 2026 Workshop on LLM Reasoning. 13 pages, 2 figures
summary: Large language models (LLMs) excel at multi-step reasoning but incur substantial inference cost. We introduce Causal Attribution Pruning (CAP), a training-free method that identifies critical attention heads by measuring their causal impact on reasoning tasks and uses these head-level scores to guide fine-grained weight pruning. For each attention head, CAP estimates the expected performance degradation when the head is masked during forward passes on a small calibration set of reasoning problems. These causal scores are then converted into weight-level importance values for the corresponding projection matrices. Unlike magnitude-only or activation-based criteria, CAP's interventional measurement directly captures each head's functional contribution, yielding relative accuracy gains of up to 61% over Wanda on ARC-Challenge at 20% sparsity. We evaluate CAP on GSM8K, StrategyQA, and ARC-Challenge using Llama-3-8B-Instruct and Mistral-7B-Instruct at 10%, 20%, and 50% sparsity. At moderate sparsity (10-20%), CAP improves over Wanda in most model-benchmark configurations. with especially large gains on ARC-Challenge for Llama-3. Our results suggest that attention-head-level causal attribution can better preserve reasoning performance on downstream benchmarks than correlational pruning criteria at equivalent sparsity, while remaining limited by coarse MLP attribution at 50% sparsity.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种名为因果归因剪枝（CAP）的无训练方法，通过测量注意力头在推理任务中的因果贡献来指导权重剪枝，在20%稀疏度下相比Wanda方法在ARC-Challenge上获得了高达61%的准确率提升。
AI.motivation: LLM在多步推理中推理成本高昂，现有剪枝方法（如基于幅度或激活值）主要依赖相关性指标，难以保留模型的推理性能，需要一种能够直接衡量每个组件功能贡献的剪枝方法。
AI.method: CAP方法对每个注意力头进行因果干预（遮挡操作），测量其在前向传播中对推理任务性能的期望下降程度，然后将头的因果得分转换为对应投影矩阵的权重级重要性值，从而实现细粒度的权重剪枝。
AI.result: 在GSM8K、StrategyQA和ARC-Challenge上使用Llama-3-8B-Instruct和Mistral-7B-Instruct评估，在10-20%中等稀疏度下CAP在多数配置上优于Wanda，在ARC-Challenge上Llama-3的准确率相对提升高达61%。但在50%高稀疏度下受限于粗粒度的MLP归因而效果有限。
AI.conclusion: 注意力头级别的因果归因在同等稀疏度下比相关性剪枝标准更能保留下游基准的推理性能，是一种有效的无训练剪枝方法。

title: Detecting Hallucinations for Large Language Model-based Knowledge Graph Reasoning
summary: Knowledge graph (KG) reasoning infers new knowledge from existing facts and is widely applied in question answering, recommendation, and decision support. With the rapid development of large language models (LLMs), LLM-based KG reasoning frameworks have become increasingly popular by leveraging retrieved KG information. However, hallucinations in LLMs remain a critical issue. Even when relevant KG knowledge is incorporated, models may still generate incorrect outputs, leading to misinformation and unreliable decisions. Existing hallucination detection methods either focus on LLM internal states or verify consistency with retrieved contexts, but both overlook the structural information in KGs, resulting in suboptimal performance. To address this gap, we propose LUCID, the first halLUcination deteCtIon method for LLM-based knowleDge graph reasoning frameworks. LUCID jointly leverages LLM attention scores, KG semantics, and structural information. Specifically, it extracts node and edge features from attention scores and semantic similarities, and integrates them with KG structure using a graph neural network. We also construct manually annotated benchmark datasets for evaluation. Experiments on nine datasets show that LUCID achieves state of the art performance compared to 15 baselines.

AI.tldr: 提出LUCID方法，利用LLM注意力分数、KG语义和结构信息检测知识图谱推理中的幻觉，在9个数据集上达到SOTA。
AI.motivation: 现有幻觉检测方法忽视KG结构信息，导致在基于LLM的KG推理框架中性能不佳。
AI.method: 从注意力分数和语义相似度中提取节点与边特征，通过图神经网络融合KG结构信息进行幻觉检测。
AI.result: 在9个数据集上相比15个基线方法取得最优性能。
AI.conclusion: LUCID通过融合KG结构信息有效提升了LLM-based KG推理中的幻觉检测效果。

title: Emergent Alignment
summary: Can Large Language Models (LLMs) discern when their own outputs are misaligned with human ethics? And can they self-correct? We endow an LLM with a conscience step that reviews its own reasoning and outputs, and we extend the training loss with an alignment component using Direct Preference Optimization (DPO) to steer the model away from non-ethical outputs. The result is an online technique to align models in a wide range of applications: training, fine-tuning, adversarial prompting, and zero-shot learning. It does not require a weaker or stronger judge, relying instead on a frozen copy of itself. In previous work, the Emergent Misalignment scenario showed a range of emergent unethical behaviors from fine-tuning the model to hack code. Instead, we empirically show how to achieve Emergent Alignment: a single high-level introspective question steers training toward an ethical model under the same code hacking scenario.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种让LLM通过自我反思实现伦理对齐的方法（Emergent Alignment），无需外部裁判，仅靠模型自身的“良心步骤”和DPO训练即可在多种场景下纠正非伦理输出。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM可能在微调或对抗提示下产生非伦理输出（如Emergent Misalignment问题），需要一种无需外部更强/更弱裁判、让模型自主识别并修正自身伦理偏差的方法。
AI.method: 在LLM中引入一个“良心步骤”（conscience step）来审查自身推理与输出；同时扩展训练损失，加入基于直接偏好优化（DPO）的对齐组件，使用模型自身的冻结副本作为参考，引导模型远离非伦理输出。
AI.result: 在代码黑客攻击等场景中，仅凭单一高层级的自省问题，即可引导模型实现Emergent Alignment，有效抑制非伦理行为，且适用于训练、微调、对抗提示和零样本学习等多种场景。
AI.conclusion: 该方法证明LLM可以通过自我反思实现伦理对齐，无需依赖外部评判模型，为模型安全对齐提供了一种轻量级、可扩展的在线方案。

title: Exploring Multi-Modal Large Language Models and Two-Stage Fine-Tuning for Fashion Image Retrieval
summary: Composed image retrieval retrieves a target image using a composed query of a reference image and a modified text description. In the fashion domain, this task requires understanding subtle attribute variations such as color, pattern, and texture. However, existing approaches face limitations due to scarce annotated data and simplistic negative sampling. We propose a novel framework that integrates a multi-modal large language model (LLaVA) to generate attribute-aware triplets and introduces a two-stage fine-tuning strategy to enhance contrastive learning. We leverage pretrained vision-language models, such as CLIP-ViT/B32, to generate and concatenate sentence-level prompts with the relative caption and to scale the number of negatives using static representations. Experimental results demonstrate enhanced compositional reasoning and improved fine-grained retrieval behavior, underscoring the feasibility and potential of the proposed framework for fashion retrieval.

AI.tldr: 提出一种结合多模态大模型LLaVA生成属性感知三元组，并采用两阶段微调策略增强对比学习的组合图像检索框架，在时尚领域检索中提升了细粒度能力。
AI.motivation: 现有组合图像检索方法面临标注数据稀缺和负采样过于简单的问题，难以捕捉颜色、图案、纹理等细微属性变化，限制了时尚领域的检索性能。
AI.method: 1) 集成LLaVA生成属性感知三元组；2) 采用两阶段微调策略增强对比学习；3) 利用CLIP-ViT/B32生成句子级提示并与相对描述拼接；4) 利用静态表示扩展负样本数量。
AI.result: 实验表明该方法增强了组合推理能力，改进了细粒度检索行为，验证了框架在时尚检索中的可行性和潜力。
AI.conclusion: 提出的框架通过引入多模态大模型和数据增强手段，有效缓解了数据稀缺和负采样问题，为时尚领域组合图像检索提供了一种可行的新方案。

title: Sign-Language Datasets at Scale: A Comprehensive Survey on Resources, Benchmarks, and Annotation Standards
comment: Accepted to ACL 2026 Main. 27 pages, 5 figures
summary: Sign languages are expressive visual languages used by Deaf and Hard-of-Hearing (DHH) communities. Despite substantial progress in sign-language recognition, translation, and production, advances remain constrained by fragmented datasets, inconsistent annotations, and limited linguistic coverage. Existing benchmarks often fail to reflect real-world communication needs, and systematic analyses of these limitations remain limited. In this survey, we present a comprehensive index of sign-language datasets, covering 120 resources across 35 sign languages. We analyze key challenges such as modality imbalance, annotation granularity, and signer bias, and outline considerations for future dataset design. We also introduce a 24-field Sign-Language Datasheet and release a public GitHub repository (https://github.com/Ginqwerty/Open-Sign-Language) to support standardized documentation and reproducible evaluation. Overall, our work provides a unified and practical foundation for developing inclusive, robust, and scalable sign-language technologies in real-world applications.

AI.tldr: 该论文对35种手语的120个数据集进行了全面综述，分析了模态不平衡、标注粒度和手语者偏差等挑战，并提出了24字段的手语数据表及开源仓库，以推动标准化和可复现的研究。
AI.motivation: 现有手语数据集存在碎片化、标注不一致、语言覆盖有限等问题，缺乏系统性的分析，阻碍了手语识别、翻译和生成技术的发展。
AI.method: 对120个覆盖35种手语的数据集进行系统梳理，分析模态、标注和偏差等关键问题，并设计24字段的标准手语数据表，同时建立公开仓库以支持标准化文档和可复现评估。
AI.result: 构建了涵盖35种手语、120个数据集的综合索引，识别出模态不平衡、标注粒度和手语者偏差等关键挑战，并发布了数据表和开源代码仓库。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为开发包容、鲁棒、可扩展的手语技术提供了一个统一且实用的基础，有助于推动真实世界应用中的手语技术进步。

title: ITNet: A Learnable Integral Transform That Subsumes Convolution, Attention, and Recurrence
summary: Convolutional networks, recurrent networks, and transformers each encode different inductive biases -- locality, sequential memory, and content-dependent pairwise interaction -- and have remained mathematically distinct since their inception. We show that this fragmentation reflects not a fundamental diversity in how signals should be processed, but rather incomplete views of a single underlying mathematical object: a learnable integral transform. We introduce the Integral Transform Network (ITNet), a unified architecture built around a learnable kernel that depends jointly on positions and features. This kernel is implemented as a small neural network, specifically an MLP, that models pairwise interactions, enabling the model to adapt its behavior from data. We show that convolution, self-attention (including multi-head), and autoregressive recurrence (including LSTM, GRU, S4, and Mamba) arise as special cases under appropriate parameterizations, and that ITNet is a universal approximator of continuous operators. To make this practical, we develop tiled kernel fusion, importance-weighted Monte Carlo integration, and learned low-rank factorization, enabling efficient and scalable computation. A single ITNet architecture with a shared operator and lightweight modality-specific encoders matches or exceeds specialized baselines on ImageNet-1K , GLUE, ModelNet40, VQA\,v2 and NLVR2. The results demonstrate that a single learned interaction mechanism can recover the behavior of all three architectural families from data.

AI.tldr: 本文提出积分变换网络（ITNet），证明卷积网络、循环网络和Transformer本质上是同一数学对象（可学习积分变换）的特殊情况，并在多个任务上达到或超越专门架构的性能。
AI.motivation: 现有三大主流架构（CNN、RNN、Transformer）各自编码不同的归纳偏置，在数学上长期被视为互不相关的模型，这种碎片化是否反映了信号处理本质上的多样性，值得探究。
AI.method: 提出积分变换网络（ITNet），核心是一个依赖位置和特征的可学习核函数（由小型MLP实现），通过tiled核融合、重要性加权蒙特卡洛积分和可学习低秩分解实现高效计算。
AI.result: 在ImageNet-1K、GLUE、ModelNet40、VQA v2和NLVR2等多个基准上，单一ITNet架构匹配或超越了对应的专门架构（CNN、Transformer、RNN）的基线性能。
AI.conclusion: 三大架构的归纳偏置并非本质差异，一个统一的可学习交互机制可以从数据中恢复所有三种架构族的行为，为构建更通用的模型提供了理论基础。

title: NEST: Narrative Event Structures in Time for Long Video Understanding
summary: Recent progress in vision-language models has enabled the processing of increasingly long video sequences, but the ability to handle extended token streams does not translate to understanding of narrative structure in long videos. Existing long video benchmarks focus on needle-in-a-haystack retrieval rather than evaluating how low-level actions form events, how events interact across time, and how narratives progress, for example, whether a model can connect an early setback, such as a job loss to a later relationship breakup, despite long gaps, intervening scenes, or flashbacks that reframe what occurred. We introduce NEST (Narrative Event Structures in Time for Long Video Understanding), a dataset of 1005 full-length movies (avg. 98 minutes), each annotated with 102 multimodal narrative events grounded in visual content, dialogue, and audio. NEST captures multimodal narrative events with structured annotations grounded in visual content, dialogue, and audio, and links them through relations that reflect narrative structure, including temporal ordering, hierarchical composition, and long-range dependencies. We introduce baselines for event trigger detection (ETD), event localization (EL), event argument extraction (EAE), and event relation extraction (ERE). The benchmark is highly challenging for grounded event discovery, with ETD below 8%, EL under 6%, and EAE below 11%. In contrast, ERE is more tractable once events are given, reaching 35.45% F1 zero-shot and 44.42% F1 after fine-tuning.

AI.tldr: 提出NEST数据集，包含1005部完整电影（平均98分钟）和102个多模态叙事事件标注，用于评估长视频叙事结构理解。实验表明事件发现任务（触发词检测<8%、定位<6%、论元抽取<11%）极具挑战性，而给定事件后关系抽取可达44.42% F1。
AI.motivation: 现有长视频基准仅关注"大海捞针式"检索，无法评估模型对叙事结构的理解，如低层动作如何构成事件、事件如何跨时间交互、叙事如何推进（如早期挫折与后期转折的关联）。
AI.method: 构建NEST数据集：从1005部完整电影中标注102个多模态叙事事件，每个事件包含视觉、对话、音频三模态的细粒度标注，并通过时序关系、层次组合、长程依赖等关系链接。设计了事件触发词检测（ETD）、事件定位（EL）、事件论元抽取（EAE）和事件关系抽取（ERE）四个基线任务。
AI.result: ETD低于8%，EL低于6%，EAE低于11%；ERE在零样本下达35.45% F1，微调后达44.42% F1。
AI.conclusion: NEST揭示了当前模型在长视频叙事事件发现上的严重不足，但事件关系抽取相对可行，为长视频叙事理解研究提供了极具挑战性的基准。

title: Quantifying Aleatoric Uncertainty of In-Context Learning for Robust Measure of LLM Prediction Confidence
summary: In-Context Learning (ICL) allows LLMs to adapt to new tasks from a few demonstrations, but its reliability remains a concern: predictions are highly sensitive to both prompt design and the model's ability to understand the context, obscuring whether failures arise from data properties or model limitations. Uncertainty decomposition-separating aleatoric from epistemic sources-is particularly crucial in this setting, yet existing methods, designed for standard generation tasks, fail to capture the unique dynamics of ICL. To address this, we introduce a concept of self-function vectors, built upon Bayesian views and the mechanistic interpretability of ICL. These vectors leverage internal model representations to model the latent concept learned during in-context prompting, thereby enabling a direct estimation of aleatoric uncertainty within a Bayesian framework and circumventing the reliance on brittle input or decoding manipulations. Given the lack of established benchmarks and suitable evaluation protocols, we also propose the first and rigorous evaluation protocol, in which data is manipulated in controlled ways so as to quantify aleatoric uncertainty precisely and separately from epistemic uncertainty. With this new evaluation framework, initially grounded in synthetic tasks for conceptual development and subsequently extended to real-world datasets, we show that our proposed methodology can measure uncertainty of LLM predictions made under ICL more reliably than existing alternative methods. Moreover, we show it can be used as a practical tool for trustworthy-related applications, such as hallucination detection. Our findings pave a new direction for connecting the quantitative view of uncertainty with the mechanistic understanding of model behavior.

AI.tldr: 本文提出基于自函数向量（self-function vectors）的概念，结合贝叶斯观点与机制可解释性，对ICL（上下文学习）中的不确定性进行分解，并设计了首个严格评估协议，在合成与真实数据集上显示该方法比现有方法更可靠地衡量不确定性，并可用于幻觉检测等可信应用。
AI.motivation: ICL对提示设计和模型理解能力高度敏感，现有不确定性分解方法无法捕捉ICL的独特动态，阻碍了区分预测失败源于数据特性还是模型局限。
AI.method: 提出自函数向量概念，利用模型内部表征对ICL中习得的潜在概念建模；在贝叶斯框架下直接估计偶然不确定性；并设计了首个可控数据操纵的评估协议以精确分离偶然不确定性与认知不确定性。
AI.result: 在合成任务和真实数据集上，该方法比现有替代方法更可靠地衡量ICL下LLM预测的不确定性，并展示了在幻觉检测等可信应用中的实用性。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为连接不确定性的量化视角与模型行为的机制理解开辟了新方向。

title: Uncertainty Decomposition for Clarification Seeking in LLM Agents
summary: Recent position papers argue that the classical aleatoric/epistemic uncertainty framework is insufficient for interactive large language model (LLM) agents and call for underspecification-aware, decomposed, and communicable uncertainty representations that can unlock new agent capabilities such as proactive clarification seeking and shared mental-model building. Practical deployment constraints -- black-box APIs, interactive latency budgets, and the absence of labeled trajectories -- rule out logprob-based, multi-sampling, and training-based methods, leaving prompt-based estimation as the most viable family for surfacing such signals at deployment time. We answer this call with a simple prompt-based decomposition that separates action confidence from request uncertainty (u), enabling the agent to ask for clarification when the task specification is ambiguous. To evaluate it, we introduce two clarification-augmented benchmarks (WebShop-Clarification and ALFWorld-Clarification) in which 50% of tasks are deliberately underspecified, and systematically compare the proposed decomposition against ReAct+UE and Uncertainty-Aware Memory (UAM) across five LLM backbones (GPT-5.1, DeepSeek-v3.2-exp, GLM-4.7, Qwen3.5-35B, GPT-OSS-120B) on these variants together with the standard WebShop, ALFWorld, and REAL benchmarks for fault detection. Averaged across the five backbones, the proposed decomposition improves clarification F1 on ALFWorld-Clarification by 73% over ReAct+UE and by 36% over UAM, and leads clarification F1 on every backbone on WebShop-Clarification and on four of five backbones on ALFWorld-Clarification, indicating that the gains generalize beyond a single LLM.

AI.tldr: 针对交互式LLM代理需要更细致的"认知不确定性"表示这一主张，本文提出了一种基于提示的简单分解方法，将动作置信度与请求不确定性分离，使代理能在任务规格模糊时主动寻求澄清。在两个新增的含50%模糊任务的基准测试上，该方法在五个大模型骨干上的澄清F1指标全面优于ReAct+UE和UAM方法。
AI.motivation: 经典的不确定性框架（aleatoric/epistemic）不足以支撑交互式LLM代理，需要面向未完全指定、可分解、可通信的不确定性表示，以解锁主动澄清和共享心智模型等新能力。同时，实际部署约束（黑盒API、延迟预算、无标注轨迹）排除了基于logprob、多次采样和训练的方法，促使探索基于提示的估计方案。
AI.method: 提出一种基于提示的分解方法，将动作置信度（action confidence）与请求不确定性（request uncertainty, u）分离。当任务规格模糊时，代理通过较高的请求不确定性触发主动向人类寻求澄清。在WebShop和ALFWorld基础上构建了两个含50%未完全指定任务的澄清增强基准，并用五个LLM骨干（GPT-5.1、DeepSeek-v3.2-exp、GLM-4.7、Qwen3.5-35B、GPT-OSS-120B）与ReAct+UE、UAM进行对比。
AI.result: 在五个骨干模型平均结果上，该方法在ALFWorld-Clarification上的澄清F1比ReAct+UE提升73%，比UAM提升36%；在WebShop-Clarification上所有骨干均领先，在ALFWorld-Clarification上五个中有四个骨干领先，表明增益可跨模型泛化。
AI.conclusion: 这种简单的提示式不确定性分解方法在实际部署场景下有效且泛化能力强，能够使LLM代理在任务模糊时主动寻求澄清，显著提升交互质量。

title: One-Shot Novel View and Pose Human Image Synthesis via 3D Prior Guided Diffusion Model
summary: This paper addresses the challenge of one-shot novel view and pose human image synthesis. The existing methods transfer the reference human image to a target pose using a set of 2D pose keypoints or synthesize human images based on generalizable human NeRF which uses human model priors to extract point-wise features. However, pose transfer based methods can not handle complex human pose using ambiguous 2D pose as the condition, while generalizable human NeRFs may be inaccurate to recover occluded/invisiable human parts without extracted reliable features. To solve these problems, we propose a novel approach for novel view and pose synthesis from a singe human image via conditional denoising diffusion model. Our diffusion model divides the novel view and pose synthesis problem into a sequence of conditional denoising steps. Specifically, to generate humans with complex and arbitrary poses, we introduce 3D human priors, i.e., 3D normal map and color prompt, as geometry and color conditions into the generation process. By transferring the reference human into the target human with a series of diffusion steps, our diffusion model enables high-quality synthesis including the occluded/invisible parts. Further, we propose a self-reconstruction based customized refinement to enhance fine details when tested on novel persons.Experimental results on different public datasets demonstrate that our approach significantly outperforms previous methods and also shows better generalization ability across datasets. The code will be made publicly available at https://github.com/Yankeegsj/3DPGDM.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于条件去噪扩散模型的方法，从单张人体图像实现新视角和新姿态合成，通过引入3D人体先验（法线图和颜色提示）作为几何与颜色条件，有效处理复杂姿态和遮挡区域，并提出了基于自重构的定制化精炼来增强细节。
AI.motivation: 现有方法中，基于2D姿态关键点的方法无法处理复杂人体姿态，而基于可泛化人体NeRF的方法在恢复遮挡/不可见部位时因缺乏可靠特征而不准确。本文旨在解决这些问题，实现高质量的新视角和新姿态合成。
AI.method: 1) 采用条件去噪扩散模型，将新视角/姿态合成问题分解为一系列条件去噪步骤；2) 引入3D人体先验（3D法线图和颜色提示）作为几何和颜色条件；3) 提出自重构的定制化精炼方法，在测试时增强细节。
AI.result: 在多个公开数据集上，该方法显著优于以往方法，并展现出更好的跨数据集泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: 扩散模型结合3D人体先验能有效解决单张人体图像的新视角和新姿态合成问题，尤其在处理复杂姿态和遮挡区域方面具有优势。

title: Granularity-Regulated Adaptive Computational Efficiency for Optimal Verification in Test-Time Scaling
summary: Test-time scaling (TTS) has emerged as a powerful paradigm for improving the reasoning performance of large language models (LLMs) by investing additional compute at inference time. A central component of TTS is the \emph{verifier}, which selects or scores candidate solutions to guide the search process. While prior work has explored the benefit of verification, a fundamental question remains underexplored: \emph{what is the optimal granularity of verification under a given compute budget?} Coarse-grained outcome reward models (ORMs) and fine-grained process reward models (PRMs) represent two extremes, yet neither alone achieves compute-optimality across all regimes. In this paper, we establish a unified theoretical framework, called \textbf{GRACE} (\underline{G}ranularity-\underline{R}egulated \underline{A}daptive \underline{C}omputational \underline{E}fficiency), that characterizes the optimal verification granularity as an explicit function of problem difficulty, verifier accuracy, and compute budget. We prove that there exists a phase transition: fine-grained verification dominates when either the compute budget is large or the problem is hard, whereas coarse-grained verification is preferred in the low-budget, easy-problem regime. Our theory unifies Best-of-$N$, beam search, and step-level MCTS within a single Pareto-optimality framework, and motivates an adaptive granularity strategy that provably achieves the compute-performance Pareto frontier. Empirical results on MATH-500, GSM8K, and AIME benchmarks corroborate all four theoretical claims, with our adaptive strategy outperforming fixed-granularity baselines by up to 3.1\% accuracy at matched compute.

AI.tldr: 本文提出统一理论框架GRACE，证明验证粒度（粗粒度ORM vs 细粒度PRM）存在相变：高预算或难题偏好细粒度，低预算或简单题偏好粗粒度，并设计自适应策略达到计算-性能帕累托最优。
AI.motivation: 现有测试时扩展方法中，验证器的粒度（粗粒度ORM与细粒度PRM）选择缺乏理论指导，两者在不同计算预算和问题难度下各有优劣，尚未有统一框架解释何时该用哪种粒度。
AI.method: 提出GRACE理论框架，将最优验证粒度形式化为问题难度、验证器准确率和计算预算的显式函数；证明相变现象；统一Best-of-N、束搜索、步级MCTS；提出自适应粒度策略。
AI.result: 在MATH-500、GSM8K和AIME基准上验证全部四个理论主张，自适应策略在相同计算量下比固定粒度基线最高提升3.1%准确率。
AI.conclusion: 验证粒度的最优选择并非一成不变，而应随计算预算和问题难度动态调整，该理论为测试时计算分配提供了统一的帕累托最优框架。

title: Analyzing the Narration Gap in LLM-Solver Loops
summary: Formal tools such as SAT and SMT solvers are increasingly embedded in language model reasoning pipelines when a safety or security critical question can be formulated in logic. Unlike chain of thought whose steps are sampled from the model distribution without formal guarantee, a solver produces a sound and independently verifiable answer. However, the soundness guarantee can be lost in the interaction between the solver and the model. The hybrid pipeline has three components: formalizing the question, deciding it, and narrating the result. Prior work has studied the formalization and decision, but not narration, which is the step that turns a formal tool's output into the user answer. To fill the narration gap, we first model the LLM-solver loop as a verified decision procedure. We further evaluate five open-sourced models under prompt injection, and we find certificate gating makes the solver verdict sound, while an adversary can invert a verified conclusion across phrasings and channels. We study the mitigation through hardened prompt that reduces injection significantly but cannot eliminate it and still suffers under adaptive attack. Combining the formal analysis and empirical studies, we show in the LLM-solver loop, robustness does not reach to the answer that the user finally reads.

AI.tldr: 大语言模型与形式化求解器（SAT/SMT）结合的推理管道中，虽然求解器能提供可靠的验证结果，但"叙述"环节（将求解器输出转化为用户可读答案）存在安全漏洞。研究发现，即使经过认证门控确保求解器结论正确，对抗攻击仍可通过提示注入翻转验证结论，且最终呈现给用户的答案缺乏鲁棒性保障。
AI.motivation: 现有工作已研究LLM-求解器管线中的形式化问题定义和求解决策环节，但忽略了"叙述"（narration）这一将求解器输出转化为用户答案的关键步骤。这一环节的缺失可能导致形式化工具的可靠性保证在最终呈现给用户时丢失。
AI.method: 1) 将LLM-求解器交互建模为可验证的决策过程；2) 在提示注入攻击下评估五个开源模型；3) 分析认证门控对求解器结论可靠性的影响；4) 通过硬化提示（hardened prompt）进行缓解实验。
AI.result: 认证门控能确保求解器结论的可靠性，但对抗攻击可以通过不同的措辞和渠道翻转已验证的结论。硬化提示能显著降低注入攻击效果，但无法完全消除，且在自适应攻击下仍然脆弱。
AI.conclusion: 在LLM-求解器循环中，即使用户通过形式化工具获得了可靠的求解结果，最终呈现给用户阅读的答案仍然缺乏鲁棒性保障，提示注入可破坏整个推理管道的完整性。

title: QueryGaussian: Scalable and Training-Free Open-Vocabulary 3D Instance Retrieval
comment: 8 pages, 4 figures, 6 tables. Accepted to the 2026 IEEE International Conference on Systems, Man, and Cybernetics (SMC 2026)
summary: Efficiently retrieving specific 3D instances from large-scale scenes via natural language prompts remains a formidable challenge in multimedia analysis. Existing approaches predominantly follow a "scene-level embedding" paradigm, which requires distilling high-dimensional semantic features into every 3D primitive. This strategy suffers from a fundamental architectural bottleneck: memory and computational costs scale linearly with scene complexity, inevitably triggering out-of-memory (OOM) failures in city-scale environments. To address this barrier, we propose QueryGaussian, a training-free framework for expeditious and scalable open-vocabulary 3D instance retrieval. Unlike holistic semantic distillation, QueryGaussian employs an instance-level query mechanism that decouples semantic understanding from geometric representation. Specifically, we leverage pre-trained 2D vision models to interpret user prompts and lift segmentation masks into 3D via a concurrent maximum-weight association strategy, ensuring semantic-visual consistency. To mitigate projection ambiguity, we introduce a temporal fusion module with multi-stage adaptive density clustering. Experimental results demonstrate that QueryGaussian not only matches the accuracy of state-of-the-art methods but also delivers a decisive efficiency leap, reducing GPU memory usage by over 70% and accelerating inference by 180x. Crucially, QueryGaussian enables expeditious instance retrieval on city-scale scenes containing tens of millions of Gaussians using consumer-grade hardware.

AI.tldr: QueryGaussian是一种无需训练的开源3D实例检索框架，通过实例级查询机制解耦语义与几何表示，在保持精度的同时将GPU内存降低70%以上，推理速度提升180倍，能在消费级硬件上实现城市级场景的快速实例检索。
AI.motivation: 现有"场景级嵌入"范式在大规模3D场景中面临内存和计算成本随场景复杂度线性增长的根本性瓶颈，容易在城市级环境中引发内存溢出（OOM）故障。
AI.method: 提出QueryGaussian框架：1）采用实例级查询机制，将语义理解与几何表示解耦；2）利用预训练2D视觉模型解析用户提示，通过并发最大权重关联策略将分割掩码提升至3D；3）引入带多阶段自适应密度聚类的时间融合模块以缓解投影歧义。
AI.result: 匹配最先进方法的精度，同时GPU内存使用降低70%以上，推理速度加速180倍，可在消费级硬件上处理包含数千万高斯量的城市级场景。
AI.conclusion: QueryGaussian实现了高效、可扩展的开放词汇3D实例检索，突破了传统方法在大规模场景下的资源限制，具有良好的实用性和可部署性。

title: Trustworthy Multi-Agent Systems: Mitigating Semantic Drift with the Argent Signaling Protocol
summary:
When multi-agent LLM systems produce bad answers, not all failures are equal: some answers are grounded in the right material but incomplete, while others are simply ungrounded and should be stopped. Current retry strategies treat both cases identically (try again and hope for the best), leaving human supervisors unable to tell whether a retry was warranted or whether the system should have halted instead.
  We introduce the Argent Signaling Protocol (ASP), a compact machine-readable header that accompanies every AI-generated response with structured quality signals: certainty (@C), grounding (@G), stochasticity (@S), and an assumption index that classifies the evidentiary basis of each claim. These signals enable a controller to distinguish repairable failures from containment failures and route each case differently.
  We evaluate ASP in two modes. In standalone mode, a 27-question document-grounded QA benchmark over the Array BioPharma/Ono license agreement compares baseline prompts against ASP-instrumented controller actions across three local GGUF models. On Qwen~(0.8B), ASP improves pass rate from 11.1% to 33.3% and mean term coverage from 36.7% to 65.4%; on Dobby~(8B), ASP produces 4 fail-to-pass recoveries, raising pass rate from 33.3% to 44.4%; on SmolLM3~(3B), ASP alternates between repair and containment per question. Aggregate improvement is meaningful (12/81 to 21/81 passes). In multi-agent mode, an ASP sidecar sits between a retrieval agent and a downstream decision agent; the sidecar blocks 100% of ungrounded upstream outputs from reaching the downstream agent (24/27 blocked, 0 ungrounded propagations).

AI.tldr: 本文提出Argent Signaling Protocol (ASP)，一种机器可读的响应头，通过结构化质量信号（确定性、接地性、随机性、假设索引）区分多智能体LLM系统中的可修复失败与需终止失败。在独立模式下，ASP将Qwen(0.8B)的通过率从11.1%提升至33.3%，Dobby(8B)从33.3%提升至44.4%。在多智能体模式下，ASP侧车成功阻止100%的无根据上游输出传播至下游决策智能体。
AI.motivation: 当前多智能体LLM系统的重试策略无法区分"有依据但不完整"的可修复失败与"完全无依据"的需终止失败，导致人工监督者无法判断重试是否合理，系统也未能在必要时及时终止。
AI.method: 设计ASP协议，为每个AI响应附加包含确定性(@C)、接地性(@G)、随机性(@S)和假设索引的结构化信号，使控制器能区分修复型失败与遏制型失败并采取不同路由策略。在独立模式和多智能体模式下，使用27个文档接地QA基准进行评估。
AI.result: 独立模式：Qwen(0.8B)通过率从11.1%升至33.3%，平均术语覆盖率从36.7%升至65.4%；Dobby(8B)实现4次失败转通过，通过率从33.3%升至44.4%。多智能体模式：侧车阻止100%无根据上游输出传播（24/27被阻断，0次无根据传播）。
AI.conclusion: ASP协议能有效区分不同类型的失败，显著提升多智能体LLM系统的整体通过率，并可靠防止无根据信息在智能体间传播，为AI系统的可控性和可审计性提供新的技术路径。

title: VFACamou: View-Fused Adversarial Camouflage for Environment-Adaptive Physical Evasion
summary: Adversarial camouflage in the physical world remains highly challenging, particularly under UAV reconnaissance where targets undergo continuous geometric changes and extreme illumination variations. Existing methods either optimize 2D digital perturbations that fail to generalize to dynamic viewpoints or produce visually unnatural textures that cannot be deployed in real scenarios. Therefore, we propose an end-to-end framework for adversarial camouflage generation that automatically produces wearable adversarial patterns and maintains stable attack performance in real physical environments with changing viewpoints, poses, and lighting conditions. Our method integrates UV-volume rendering with a diffusion-based texture generator, enabling consistent appearance under varying scales, poses, and lighting conditions. To ensure environmental realism, we propose an illumination color consistency estimator that extracts dominant background attributes and guides a natural texture loss to align the generated UV texture with the surrounding environment. A multi-scale dynamic training strategy further enhances robustness against viewpoint shifts and body deformation. Extensive experiments across multiple mainstream detectors demonstrate that our method achieves strong and stable physical attack performance while maintaining high perceptual naturalness, reducing human detection rates without introducing unnatural artifacts.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种端到端的物理对抗伪装生成框架，结合UV体积渲染与扩散纹理生成器，在真实无人机侦察场景下实现多视角、多姿态、多光照的稳定攻击性能，并保持纹理自然。
AI.motivation: 现有物理伪装方法在无人机侦察场景下存在两大瓶颈：2D数字扰动无法泛化到动态视角，生成的纹理视觉上不自然且无法实际部署。亟需一种能在真实物理环境中保持稳定攻击性能且视觉自然的对抗伪装生成方法。
AI.method: 1) UV体积渲染+扩散纹理生成器实现跨视角/姿态/光照的一致性外观；2) 光照颜色一致性估计器提取背景主色调，引导自然纹理损失；3) 多尺度动态训练策略增强对视角变化和身体变形的鲁棒性。
AI.result: 在多个主流检测器上的实验表明，该方法实现了强大且稳定的物理攻击性能，同时保持高感知自然度，降低了人类检测率且未引入不自然伪影。
AI.conclusion: 所提框架有效解决了物理对抗伪装在动态无人机侦察场景下的视角、光照和姿态泛化难题，兼顾攻击鲁棒性与视觉自然性，具备实际部署潜力。

title: Characterizing Narrative Content in Web-scale LLM Pretraining Data
comment: 8 pages of main content, 28 total pages. 30 figures
summary: The narrative composition of web-scale LLM pretraining corpora remains largely unexplored even though narrative is a fundamental mode of human communication. We present the first fine-grained study of narrative features in Dolma, a 3-trillion-token open pretraining corpus. Drawing on narrative theory, we design a framework spanning three core narrative elements (agency, setting, and events) operationalized as 11 interpretable dimensions. After sampling and annotating a diverse set of 400 passages, we finetune and validate NarraBERT, a RoBERTa-based model for fine-grained narrative prediction. We apply NarraBERT to 3M passages, resulting in a new dataset, NarraDolma. We find (i) narrative structure is measurable at scale across extremely heterogeneous data, (ii) we uncover a continuous, multidimensional narrative structure underlying web text, and (iii) narrative qualities are unequally distributed across pretraining sources and topics in ways that current curation practices neither measure nor account for. Our framework, dataset, and analyses provide a foundation for understanding how narrative qualities are distributed in LLM pretraining data and for studying how data composition affects narrative reasoning tasks. We publicly release NarraDolma and NarraBERT.

AI.tldr: 本文首次对大型语言模型预训练语料库中的叙事特征进行了细粒度研究，提出了一个包含三大核心叙事要素（能动性、背景、事件）的分析框架，开发了NarraBERT模型进行自动标注，并创建了NarraDolma数据集。研究发现叙事结构在异构网络文本中可测量、呈现连续多维分布，且叙事质量在不同来源和主题间存在不均等分布。
AI.motivation: 尽管叙事是人类交流的基本模式，但网络规模的大语言模型预训练语料库的叙事构成仍未被充分探索。
AI.method: 基于叙事理论设计包含三大核心要素（能动性、背景、事件）共11个可解释维度的分析框架。对Dolma语料库中400个多样化段落进行采样和标注，微调并验证了基于RoBERTa的NarraBERT模型，最终将其应用于300万个段落，生成NarraDolma数据集。
AI.result: (1) 叙事结构可在极端异构的数据中进行大规模测量；(2) 网络文本背后存在连续的多维叙事结构；(3) 叙事质量在预训练数据来源和主题间分布不均，而当前的数据整理实践既未测量也未考虑这一点。
AI.conclusion: 该研究提供了理解LLM预训练数据中叙事质量分布的基础，为研究数据组成如何影响叙事推理任务奠定基础，并公开发布了NarraDolma和NarraBERT。

title: Which Pairs to Compare for LLM Post-Training?
summary: Preference-based post-training has become a central paradigm for aligning language models. A common data-collection strategy is to generate a small set of completions for each prompt and label the resulting comparison pairs. However, human preference labels are often much more expensive than generating additional completions, suggesting a different use of the same labeling budget: generate a larger pool of completions, but label only the most informative comparison pairs. This paper studies which pairs should be compared in preference-based post-training. We formulate comparison curation as a sampling-design problem and evaluate designs by the quality of the final policy under the preference-based post-training objective. We instantiate this framework for Direct Preference Optimization (DPO), analyzing how the choice of labeled pairs propagates through DPO training to downstream policy performance. Our main results provide matching upper and lower bounds on the post-training optimality gap of the DPO-trained policy. The bounds show that comparison selection affects downstream performance through a single design-dependent information matrix, which links label allocation to parameter estimation error and policy suboptimality. This yields an explicit optimization criterion for budgeted comparison curation and motivates practical sampling designs for selecting informative pairs from large generated completion pools. Experiments on synthetic settings and language-model post-training benchmarks show that the proposed designs consistently improve sample efficiency over common comparison-selection heuristics.

AI.tldr: 本文研究在偏好对齐的后训练中，如何从大量生成补全池中挑选最具信息量的比较对进行标注，以在有限标注预算下提升策略性能。
AI.motivation: 人工偏好标注成本远高于生成补全，因此需要在固定预算下选择最有效的比较对，而非对所有生成结果进行标注。
AI.method: 将比较对筛选形式化为采样设计问题，利用信息矩阵连接标注分配与参数估计误差，推导DPO训练的最优性间隙上下界，并据此提出优化准则。
AI.result: 给出了DPO训练策略最优性间隙的紧上下界，表明比较选择通过一个依赖设计的信息矩阵影响下游性能，并提出了实用的采样设计方案。
AI.conclusion: 在合成实验和语言模型后训练基准上，所提设计在样本效率上一致优于常用比较选择启发式方法。

title: Reliability without Validity: A Systematic, Large-Scale Evaluation of LLM-as-a-Judge Models Across Agreement, Consistency, and Bias
summary: LLM-as-a-Judge has become the dominant evaluation paradigm for language models, but judge validation in practice relies on exact-match agreement, a metric that does not correct for chance and systematically overstates discriminative ability. We present the largest systematic evaluation of LLM-as-a-Judge to date: 21 judges from nine providers across MT-Bench, JudgeBench, and RewardBench, evaluated under three protocols (agreement, consistency, bias audit) over 118 runs and approximately 541,000 individual judgments. Four findings emerge, consistent across the full cohort, including the April 2026 frontier: kappa deflation between exact match and Cohen's kappa is universal (33--41 pp on MT-Bench), judge rankings shift by up to 14 positions across benchmarks, high test--retest reliability (>0.95) coexists with severe position bias (>0.10) in two production-deployed judges (instantiating a consistency--bias paradox), and verbosity bias is small (<0.011) across our cohort under a single pairwise rubric. We distill these into a Minimum Viable Validation Protocol.

AI.tldr: 本文对LLM作为裁判的评价范式进行了迄今为止最大规模的系统评估，发现精确匹配指标会系统性高估判别能力，并揭示了kappa通缩、排名变动、一致性-偏差悖论等关键问题，最后提出了最小可行验证协议。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM裁判验证依赖精确匹配指标，该指标未校正随机一致性，系统性高估了判别能力，亟需更可靠的评估方法。
AI.method: 对9个提供商的21个裁判模型，在MT-Bench、JudgeBench、RewardBench三个基准上，采用一致性、稳定性和偏差审计三种协议，进行了118轮实验和约54.1万次独立判断。
AI.result: 四个核心发现：精确匹配与Cohen's kappa之间普遍存在33-41个百分点的通缩；不同基准上裁判排名最多变化14位；高重测信度与严重位置偏差共存于两个生产部署裁判中；单一成对评估标准下冗长偏差较小。
AI.conclusion: 现有LLM裁判验证方法存在严重缺陷，需采用校正了随机一致性的指标和更全面的验证协议，论文提出了最小可行验证协议作为解决方案。

authors: Antonio de Sousa Leitão Filho; Allan Kardec Duailibe Barros Filho; Fabrício Saul Lima; Selby Mykael Lima dos Santos; Rejani Bandeira Vieira Sousa
title: Toten: Knowledge-Based Ontological Tokenization Of Physical Quantities And Technical Notation In Brazilian Portuguese
summary: Byte-Pair Encoding tokenization is statistically efficient for vocabulary compression, but semantically blind to structured technical entities, fragmenting physical quantities, numbers, units, and symbolic expressions into lexically arbitrary subwords. We present TOTEN, a knowledge-based ontological tokenization framework that replaces statistical derivation with declarative classification grounded in a formal ontology of engineering entities (OEE). We formalize TOTEN as the triple <O, classify, {inst_tau}>: the ontology gathers types, structural principles, composition relations, and preservable invariants; the classification function maps raw text into typed regions; and the instantiator family yields a self-descriptive structured representation. Robustness derives from deterministic coupling with three external oracles: Pint (dimensional), Unicode Character Database (typographic), and RSLP (Portuguese morphology). Intrinsic evaluation covers four properties verifiable by construction -- ontological atomicity, dimensional equivalence, typographic robustness, and numerical reconstruction -- over an internal, physically validated benchmark (EngQuant, N=800) and four Brazilian Portuguese external corpora (N=1771 eligible cases). We also report detection recall, distinguishing coverage from conditional atomicity. Against eight state-of-the-art baselines, TOTEN achieves unit ontological atomicity in all contrasts and numerical reconstruction of 0.775-0.904 on external corpora, vs. 0.627-0.703 for the best baseline (Quantulum3); on EngQuant, 0.780 vs. 0.340. Differences are statistically significant (McNemar with Holm correction). Spearman correlation between internal and external rankings confirms concurrent validity of the control benchmark. Dimensional equivalence shows statistical parity with Pint, the oracle from which the system inherits dimensional authority.

AI.tldr: TOTEN是一种基于本体论的知识驱动分词框架，通过声明式分类取代统计驱动的BPE分词，在工程实体（如物理量、单位、符号表达式）的分词中实现了更高的本体原子性和数值重建精度，显著优于现有基线模型。
AI.motivation: BPE分词在压缩词汇表上高效，但对结构化的技术实体（如物理量、数字、单位、符号表达式）语义盲视，将其分割成词汇上任意子词，破坏了语义完整性。
AI.method: 提出TOTEN框架，形式化为三元组<O, classify, {inst_tau}>：O为工程实体本体论（OEE），classify将原始文本映射为类型化区域，inst_tau生成自描述结构化表示；系统与Pint（量纲）、Unicode字符数据库（排版）、RSLP（葡萄牙语形态）三个外部预言机确定性耦合。
AI.result: 在EngQuant基准（N=800）和四个巴西葡萄牙语外部语料库（N=1771）上，TOTEN在单位本体原子性上全面领先，数值重建达0.775-0.904（外部语料）和0.780（EngQuant），最佳基线Quantulum3仅0.627-0.703和0.340，差异统计显著（McNemar+Holm校正）。内部与外部排名Spearman相关验证了控制基准的同时效度。量纲等价性与Pint统计持平。
AI.conclusion: 基于本体论的知识驱动分词方法在结构化技术实体处理上显著优于统计驱动的BPE，验证了本体论在工程文本分词中的有效性。

title: LaViSA: A Language and Vision Structural Ambiguity Benchmark
summary: Structural ambiguity arises when a single sentence admits multiple valid interpretations due to its syntactic structure, posing a fundamental challenge for language understanding. Visual scenes serve as useful cues for resolving such ambiguity, and Vision and Language Models (VLMs) need to be capable of deriving possible semantic interpretations from visual scenes. We introduce Language and Vision Structural Ambiguity (LaViSA), a benchmark designed to evaluate the ability of VLMs to resolve structural ambiguity leveraging visual scenes. LaViSA consists of ambiguous sentences, their disambiguated sentences, and corresponding images of these disambiguated sentences across seven ambiguity categories. Using LaViSA, we conduct a comprehensive evaluation of diverse VLMs, including both proprietary and open-source models with varying parameter scales and reasoning capabilities. Experimental results show that although recent VLMs can leverage visual scenes to resolve structural ambiguity to a some extent, they still struggle with certain ambiguity types and visually subtle semantic distinctions, indicating remaining limitations in resolving structural ambiguity using visual scenes.

AI.tldr: 本文提出LaViSA基准，用于评估视觉语言模型利用视觉场景解决句法结构歧义的能力。实验发现现有模型虽能部分解决歧义，但在某些歧义类型和细微视觉语义区分上仍存在局限。
AI.motivation: 句法结构歧义是语言理解的 fundamental 挑战，视觉场景可作为解决歧义的有效线索，但目前缺乏系统性评估 VLMs 利用视觉场景解决结构歧义能力的基准。
AI.method: 构建LaViSA基准，包含歧义句子、消歧句子及对应图片，涵盖7种歧义类别；对多种VLMs（含闭源/开源、不同参数规模及推理能力）进行全面评估。
AI.result: 当前VLMs虽能在一定程度上利用视觉场景解决结构歧义，但在特定歧义类型及视觉上细微的语义区分上表现不佳。
AI.conclusion: VLMs在利用视觉场景解决结构歧义方面仍存在显著局限，需要进一步改进。

title: AI4SE and SE4AI Exploration: A Decade Looking Back and Forward
summary: The March 2020 INCOSE INSIGHT special issue on AI and Systems Engineering (SE) became the most downloaded issue in the publication's history and launched a research community that now draws over 250 registrants to its annual workshop. In this article, we trace the progress in AI and SE across three phases (labeled here foundational, applied, and LLM inflection) based on the authors' reading of the field's core papers, and describe our opinions of where the community has converged and where critical gaps remain. Separately, a human-AI agreement literature review leveraging both human expertise and six AI models was performed to assess the relevance of 1,712 INCOSE INSIGHT articles and 889 SERC publications. The results identify five critical research gaps and offer guidance for practitioners navigating AI adoption, assurance, and workforce transformation in SE. We share the agreement data and the AI4SE/SE4AI Explorer web application so readers can compare their own relevance judgments with the human and AI raters.

AI.tldr: 本文梳理了AI与系统工程(SE)融合的三个阶段（基础、应用、LLM转折），通过人工与AI模型对2,601篇文献进行相关性评估，识别出五个关键研究空白，并开发了AI4SE/SE4AI Explorer应用供读者对比判断。
AI.motivation: INCOSE INSIGHT的AI与SE特刊成为史上下载量最高的一期，并催生了超过250人参加的年度研讨会，表明该领域关注度激增，亟需系统梳理进展、识别研究空白，为从业者提供指导。
AI.method: 作者通过文献阅读将AI与SE进展划分为三个阶段；同时进行了人-AI一致性文献综述，结合人类专家和6个AI模型，对1,712篇INCOSE INSIGHT文章和889篇SERC出版物进行相关性评估。
