Extensive evaluations show that across 17 memory-requiring simulation tasks and 4 real-world bimanual tasks, EventVLA achieves an average success rate improvement of +40% over state-of-the-art memory-augmented VLAs.

AI.tldr: 提出EventVLA框架，通过稀疏视觉证据记忆（基础视觉锚点+动态关键帧证据记忆KEM模块）解决长程机器人操作中的记忆瓶颈问题，在17个模拟和4个真实双手机器人任务中平均成功率提升40%。
AI.motivation: 现有VLA策略在处理长程机器人操作时，当任务关键线索随时间被遮挡或不可观测时容易失败；现有记忆增强方法存在信息瓶颈、高延迟或冗余视觉信息积累等问题。
AI.method: 提出EventVLA框架，包含两个核心组件：1) 基础视觉锚点，保留初始和短期上下文；2) 动态关键帧证据记忆(KEM)模块，从VLA潜在嵌入直接预测未来关键帧概率，自主捕获和存储稀疏、任务关键的视觉事件。
AI.result: 在17个需要记忆的模拟任务和4个真实双手机器人任务中，EventVLA相比最先进的记忆增强VLA方法，平均成功率提升40%。
AI.conclusion: EventVLA通过前瞻性的稀疏视觉证据记忆机制，有效解决了长程机器人操作中的记忆瓶颈，显著提升了在非马尔可夫操作任务中的性能。

title: Actionable Activation Directions for Detecting and Mitigating Emergent Misalignment Across Language Model Families
summary: Fine-tuning language models on insecure code induces emergent misalignment with poorly understood internal structure. We investigate whether this misalignment corresponds to a causally actionable activation-space direction shared across architectures. Across four instruction-tuned model families (Qwen2.5-1.5B, Gemma-2-2B, Llama-3.2-1B, Ministral-3-3B) finetuned identically, a difference-in-means direction achieves 99.6% separation of aligned and misaligned activations at each model's final layer. Causal steering by subtracting this direction reduces code spillover by 21-51 points, while a secure-code control confirms content specificity. Cross-architecture transfer via ridge regression maps yields large behavioral suppression (up to 46 points) but fails specificity controls as random and orthogonal directions perform comparably. We identify a two-tier specificity structure: within-model directions are causally specific and actionable; cross-model directions are causally real but non-specific. An asymmetric transfer topology emerges, with Gemma and Qwen acting as geometric donors and Llama as a receiver. These findings define the limits of linear cross-architecture correction and recommend within-model probing for auditing.

AI.tldr: 在四个指令微调模型上，通过不安全代码微调引发的对齐偏差存在一个共同的激活空间方向，该方向在模型内部具有因果可操作性，但跨架构迁移时失去特异性，揭示了线性干预的局限性和非对称迁移拓扑。
AI.motivation: 探究语言模型因不安全代码微调产生的对齐偏差是否对应一个跨架构共享的、因果可操作的激活空间方向。
AI.method: 对Qwen2.5-1.5B、Gemma-2-2B、Llama-3.2-1B、Ministral-3-3B四个模型进行相同的微调，使用均值差异方向进行激活分离，通过因果干预（减法操舵）评估效果，并利用岭回归映射进行跨架构迁移分析。
AI.result: 均值差异方向在最后一层实现了99.6%的分离准确率；模型内干预使代码溢出降低21-51个百分点；跨架构迁移虽能抑制高达46个百分点的行为，但随机和正交方向表现相当，缺乏特异性。
AI.conclusion: 存在两级特异性结构：模型内方向因果特异且可操作，跨模型方向因果存在但非特异。Gemma和Qwen作为几何供体，Llama作为受体，建议采用模型内探测进行审计。

title: Modularity-Free Conflict-Averse Training for Generalized PINNs
summary: Physics-informed neural networks (PINNs) have become a powerful framework for solving PDEs by embedding physical laws into differentiable objectives. Despite their advances, training PINNs remains fragile: recent conflict-averse optimization schemes alleviate gradient interference between residual and boundary losses, but we show that their effectiveness deteriorates as model capacity increases. In this paper, we identify a capacity-induced failure mode, where overparameterized networks undergo functional modularity, self-partitioning into task-exclusive modules that suppress cross-objective interaction and hinder convergence toward Pareto-stationary points. To address this issue, we propose a novel framework, Modular-Sparsity Synchronization (ModSync), which integrates structural optimization into conflict-averse training by penalizing task-exclusive connections while preserving interaction-promoting pathways. Extensive experiments across diverse PDE benchmarks demonstrate that ModSync consistently prevents capacity-driven failures, sustains robust cross-objective coupling, and achieves state-of-the-art accuracy. Codes are available at \url{https://github.com/heejokong/ModSync}.

AI.tldr: 本文发现过参数化PINN会自组织成任务专用模块，抑制跨目标交互导致训练失败，提出ModSync通过惩罚任务专用连接来保持跨目标耦合，达到SOTA精度。
AI.motivation: 现有冲突规避优化方案在模型容量增大时效果退化，因为过参数化网络会形成功能模块化，抑制残差损失与边界损失之间的跨目标交互，阻碍收敛到Pareto驻点。
AI.method: 提出Modular-Sparsity Synchronization (ModSync)框架，将结构优化集成到冲突规避训练中，惩罚任务专用连接（模块内连接），同时保留促进跨目标交互的连接路径。
AI.result: 在多种PDE基准上，ModSync有效防止容量驱动的训练失效，维持鲁棒的跨目标耦合，达到最先进的精度。
AI.conclusion: ModSync通过结构稀疏化同步解决了过参数化PINN中的功能模块化问题，为大规模物理信息神经网络训练提供了可靠方案。

title: MakeupMirror: Improving Facial Attribute Preservation in Diffusion Models for Makeup Transfer
summary: Makeup transfer models enable fun augmented reality (AR) experiences as well as virtual try-on (VTO) for online makeup shopping. While recent state-of-the-art diffusion based solutions such as Stable-Makeup dramatically improve the accuracy and realism of makeup transfer, they still face limitations in identity and skin color preservation, making production-level VTO for makeup shopping unrealistic. In this work, we propose MakeupMirror, a diffusion-based approach to makeup transfer that makes significant progress towards preserving facial features and skin tone. We introduce several technical innovations over Stable-Makeup: (1) integration of facial geometry conditioning with ControlNets to maintain facial fidelity; (2) region-specific makeup transfer control to enable precise makeup application across facial regions such as skin, eyes and lips; (3) skin tone-based makeup transfer modulation that prevent skin tone alteration in cross-subject transfer scenarios; and (4) integration of a Levenberg-Marquardt Langevin sampler to speed up inference while maintaining generation quality. Our experiments on CPM-Real, Makeup Wild, and (herein newly collected, more diverse) MakeupSelfies datasets show that MakeupMirror improves relative facial recognition similarity by +60%, reduces relative skin tone difference by -50% over Stable-Makeup, with a latency of 0.7s, while achieving expert acceptance rate of 94% across core facial identity preservation criteria.

AI.tldr: 本文提出MakeupMirror，一种基于扩散模型的妆容迁移方法，通过集成面部几何条件控制、区域特定妆容迁移、肤色调制等技术创新，在保留面部特征和肤色的同时实现高质量妆容迁移，性能显著优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 现有基于扩散模型的妆容迁移方法（如Stable-Makeup）在身份特征和肤色保留方面仍存在局限性，使得生产级别的虚拟试妆在美妆购物中难以实现。
AI.method: 在Stable-Makeup基础上引入四项创新：(1)利用ControlNets集成面部几何条件以保持面部保真度；(2)区域特定妆容迁移控制实现精准分区上妆；(3)基于肤色的妆容迁移调制防止跨主体迁移时的肤色改变；(4)集成Levenberg-Marquardt Langevin采样器加速推理同时保持生成质量。
AI.result: 在CPM-Real、Makeup Wild和新收集的MakeupSelfies数据集上，相比Stable-Makeup，面部识别相似度提升60%，肤色差异减少50%，推理延迟0.7秒，核心身份保留标准的专家接受率达94%。
AI.conclusion: MakeupMirror在面部特征和肤色保留方面取得了显著进展，使基于扩散模型的妆容迁移更接近生产级虚拟试妆应用要求。

title: The Register Gap: A Meaning Intelligence Framework for Nigerian Public Discourse
comment: Preprint. 12 pages, 2 tables. Supplementary materials: MIF Master Specification v2.0, Annotation Guidelines v1.0, and 30-item public calibration set with gold labels available from the author
summary: We introduce the Meaning Intelligence Framework (MIF), a nine-dimension annotation and evaluation schema for Nigerian public discourse that separates surface sentiment from true communicative intent. Existing benchmarks for Nigerian languages, including NaijaSenti and AfriSenti, treat sentiment classification as a three-way polarity task (positive, negative, neutral). We argue that the dominant failure mode of AI systems on Nigerian discourse is not translation failure but context failure: the same utterance carries opposite pragmatic force depending on speaker, audience, and situation. The MIF operationalises this insight across nine scored dimensions: register, surface sentiment, true intent, irony, coded subtext, risk tier, annotator confidence, speaker emotion, and recommended communications action. We construct a 30-item calibration dataset spanning Standard English, Nigerian English, Nigerian Pidgin, and code-mixed registers, and evaluate a frontier language model (Gemini 2.5 Flash) under zero-shot and schema-informed prompting conditions. The headline finding is the Register Gap: zero-shot register classification accuracy is 33.3%, rising to 73.3% (+40 points) when the model receives the MIF schema in-context. The composite Meaning Intelligence Score increases by 5.4 points (73.2 to 78.6) under schema-informed prompting, with the largest practical gains in register identification, coded-subtext detection (+10 points), and strategic action recommendation (+10.3 points). We release the framework specification, annotation guidelines, and the 30-item public calibration set to support reproducibility, while retaining a private holdout corpus for contamination-protected evaluation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出意义智能框架（MIF），一个九维度注释与评估体系，用于分析尼日利亚公共话语中的真实交际意图。研究发现，AI系统在尼日利亚话语上的主要失败模式不是翻译失败，而是语境失败。通过30项校准数据集评估，注册分类准确率从零样本的33.3%提升至73.3%（+40点），意义智能分数提升5.4分。
AI.motivation: 现有基准（如NaijaSenti、AfriSenti）仅将情感分类视为三值极性任务（正面、负面、中性），无法捕捉尼日利亚话语中同一话语因说话者、受众和情境不同而产生的相反语用力量。AI系统的主要失败模式是语境失败而非翻译失败。
AI.method: 提出九维度注释体系：语域、表面情感、真实意图、讽刺、编码潜台词、风险等级、注释者置信度、说话者情绪、推荐沟通行动。构建30项校准数据集，覆盖标准英语、尼日利亚英语、尼日利亚皮钦语及语码混合语域，评估Gemini 2.5 Flash在零样本和模式引导提示条件下的表现。
AI.result: 零样本注册分类准确率为33.3%，模式引导后提升至73.3%（+40点）。复合意义智能分数从73.2提升至78.6（+5.4点）。编码潜台词检测提升10点，战略行动推荐提升10.3点。
AI.conclusion: MIF框架能显著提升AI对尼日利亚公共话语的理解能力，特别是在语域识别、编码潜台词检测和战略行动推荐方面。发布框架规范、注释指南和30项公共校准集以支持可重复性，同时保留私有保留语料库用于防污染评估。

title: Implicit Semantic-Aware Communication Based on Hypergraph Reasoning
comment: This work is accepted at IEEE Transactions on Communications
summary: Semantic-aware communication has emerged as a transformative paradigm for next-generation communication systems, shifting the fundamental goal from transmitting bit-level symbols to reliably recovering and understanding the semantic meaning of information. Previous studies have demonstrated that representing the semantic content of source messages as graph-based structures can significantly improve communication efficiency and the accuracy of semantic inference at the receiver. However, existing solutions typically employ graphs that capture only pairwise relationships, thereby neglecting higher-order implicit correlations commonly observed in real-world scenarios, such as group interactions, multi-entity associations, and complex relational contexts. This limitation reduces semantic expressiveness and makes semantic inference susceptible to ambiguity and performance degradation, particularly under noisy or corrupted channel conditions. To address these issues, this paper proposes a novel hypergraph-based implicit semantic reasoning framework, HISR, which leverages hypergraphs to represent complex multi-entity relationships among semantic knowledge entities. In HISR, entities and their associated higher-order relations are mapped into dedicated semantic subspaces tailored to distinct relational contexts. This design not only disentangles diverse semantic interactions to mitigate the over-smoothing effects commonly found in traditional graph embedding methods but also enables robust semantic inference even when partial information loss occurs during transmission. Numerical results show that the proposed HISR achieves up to a 36.6% improvement in implicit semantic interpretation accuracy over the state-of-the-art benchmarks.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种基于超图的隐式语义推理框架HISR，通过将多实体高阶关系映射到专用语义子空间，在嘈杂信道条件下实现了比现有方法最高36.6%的语义推理准确率提升。
AI.motivation: 现有语义通信方法基于简单图结构仅能捕获成对关系，忽视了现实场景中常见的多实体关联、群体交互等复杂高阶关系，导致语义表达能力不足，在噪声信道下易出现模糊和性能退化。
AI.method: 提出超图隐式语义推理框架HISR，利用超图建模多实体高阶关系，将实体及关联映射到不同语义子空间中，以解耦多样化语义交互并缓解传统图嵌入的过平滑问题。
AI.result: 在隐式语义解释准确率上，HISR相比现有最优方法提升了最高36.6%。
AI.conclusion: 超图结构能有效建模复杂语义关系，即使在部分信息丢失的信道条件下也能实现鲁棒的语义推理，是下一代语义通信系统的有效范式。

title: PsyScore: A Psychometrically-Aware Framework for Trait-Adaptive Essay Scoring and ZPD-Scaffolded Feedback
summary: Effective Automated Essay Scoring (AES) are expected to support both reliable assessment and actionable instructional feedback. However, existing approaches often treat scoring and feedback as separate components: neural scoring models provide limited interpretability, while Large Language Model (LLM)-based feedback is typically insensitive to learners proficiency levels. To address this fragmentation, this work proposes PsyScore, a psychometrically-aware framework that integrates diagnostic assessment with instructional scaffolding through a shared latent ability representation. PsyScore comprises three key modules: a Trait-Adaptive Neural IRT Scorer that incorporates the Graded Partial Credit Model (GPCM) into a neural architecture, enabling the precise estimation of student ability while maintaining psychometric interpretability, a ZPD-Scaffolded Feedback Generator, which conditions multi-agent feedback strategies on the diagnosed ability parameter to adapt instructional focus across different proficiency levels, and a Multi-Perspective Feedback Evaluation Strategy that assesses feedback quality via pairwise preference judgements and student revision simulations. Experiments on the ASAP++ dataset demonstrate that PsyScore achieves competitive scoring performance while providing more pedagogically aligned feedback.

AI.tldr: PsyScore是一个心理测量感知的自动作文评分与反馈框架，通过共享潜在能力表征，将诊断性评估与教学支架整合，在保持评分性能的同时提供更具教学导向的反馈。
AI.motivation: 现有方法将评分与反馈分离：神经评分模型可解释性差，而基于LLM的反馈对学生能力水平不敏感，导致评估与教学脱节。
AI.method: 包含三个模块：1) 基于GPCM的Trait-Adaptive Neural IRT Scorer实现心理测量可解释的评分；2) ZPD-Scaffolded Feedback Generator根据诊断能力调整教学反馈策略；3) Multi-Perspective Feedback Evaluation Strategy通过偏好判断和修订模拟评估反馈质量。
AI.result: 在ASAP++数据集上，PsyScore取得了具有竞争力的评分性能，同时提供了更具教学一致性的反馈。
AI.conclusion: 通过共享能力表征将评分与反馈统一在同一框架下，有望在自动化评估中兼顾诊断准确性与教学指导性。

title: WeGenBench: A Multidimensional Diagnostic Benchmark towards Text-to-Image Model Optimization
summary: Recent text-to-image generation models have demonstrated remarkable capabilities in synthesizing highly realistic images from text inputs alone. Although existing benchmarks can evaluate the generation capabilities of various models to some extent, they struggle to comprehensively and accurately measure performance across multiple dimensions, often failing to reveal the inherent deficiencies of models in specific categories. To address these limitations, we propose WeGenBench, a novel benchmark designed for the comprehensive, multi-perspective evaluation of text-to-image generation capabilities. Our benchmark comprises a total of 4,000 test prompts across two primary categories, meticulously balanced between Chinese and English to evaluate bilingual and cross-cultural generation capabilities. Beyond macroscopic scene classification, we annotate each prompt with multi-dimensional tags tailored to the distinct content and challenges of each language, thereby refining the generation tasks into more specific sub-categories. Through a cross-dimensional evaluation mechanism leveraging both scene classifications and multi-dimensional tags, WeGenBench can precisely pinpoint model shortcomings in specific generation categories. Furthermore, to measure generation quality more accurately, we design and validate several novel evaluation metrics by integrating Vision-Language Models (VLMs), which assess model performance on domain-specific tasks from three core aspects. Crucially, our approach yields both the assessment outcomes and the detailed reasoning trajectories, facilitating a rigorous verification of the accuracy and soundness of the evaluation results. Finally, we conduct systematic benchmarking on current state-of-the-art methods and provide an in-depth analysis of the limitations present in existing models.

AI.tldr: WeGenBench是一个用于全面、多维度评估文本到图像生成能力的基准测试，包含4000个测试提示（中英文各半），通过多维标签和跨维度评估机制精准定位模型缺陷，并设计了基于视觉语言模型的新评估指标。
AI.motivation: 现有基准测试难以全面准确地衡量文本到图像生成模型在多维度上的性能，且无法揭示模型在特定类别中的固有缺陷。
AI.method: 构建包含4000个双语测试提示的WeGenBench基准，设计多维标签标注机制，提出基于视觉语言模型的新型评估指标，并通过场景分类与多维标签的交叉评估来定位模型缺陷。
AI.result: WeGenBench能够精准定位模型在特定生成类别中的不足，同时提供评估结果与详细推理轨迹，并通过系统基准测试揭示了当前最先进方法的局限性。
AI.conclusion: WeGenBench为文本到图像生成模型的全面评估提供了更准确、更精细的框架，有助于揭示和解决现有模型的缺陷。

title: Beyond Accuracy: Measuring Logical Compliance of Predictive Models
summary: Machine learning models are predominantly evaluated through predictive performance metrics such as ranking quality, prediction error, or classification accuracy. While these metrics effectively quantify how closely predictions match the ground truth, they do not assess whether model outputs respect predefined logical or domain-specific constraints. In high-stakes applications, including healthcare, finance, and autonomous systems, logical consistency can be as critical as predictive accuracy, yet no standard metric captures this dimension. We introduce the Rule Violation Score (RVS), a complementary evaluation metric that quantifies the extent to which a predictive model respects a given set of logical rules, independently of predictive accuracy. RVS treats hard rules (strict constraints) and soft rules (statistical regularities) differently, can be evaluated on any dataset and on any predictive model expressed over a relational vocabulary, and can be computed using SQL queries that are automatically generated for Horn rules. Beyond evaluating models, RVS can also evaluate the logical consistency of training datasets and help identify poorly defined rules. We evaluate RVS on three benchmarks covering knowledge graph link prediction and relational regression, including rule-based, embedding-based, and neuro-symbolic predictive models. Our results demonstrate that two models achieving comparable predictive accuracy can exhibit substantially different levels of logical compliance, revealing differences in model behavior that standard metrics fail to capture.

AI.tldr: 提出规则违反分数(RVS)，一种独立于预测精度、用于评估模型输出是否符合逻辑规则的新指标，并通过实验证明其能捕捉标准指标忽视的模型行为差异。
AI.motivation: 现有评估指标仅关注预测精度，无法衡量模型输出是否符合预定义的逻辑或领域约束，而在医疗、金融等高风险应用中逻辑一致性至关重要。
AI.method: 定义规则违反分数(RVS)，区分硬规则(严格约束)和软规则(统计规律)；基于关系词汇表达任意预测模型；通过Horn规则自动生成SQL查询计算RVS。
AI.result: 在知识图谱链接预测和关系回归三个基准上验证发现，预测精度相近的两个模型可能在逻辑合规性上存在显著差异，标准指标无法捕捉这些行为差异。
AI.conclusion: RVS可作为预测精度的补充评估指标，揭示模型在逻辑一致性方面的行为差异，还可用于评估训练数据集的逻辑一致性和识别定义不佳的规则。

title: Geometry-Preserving in 3D Gaussian Splatting for LiDAR-Camera Extrinsic Calibration
comment: Accepted to ECCV 2026. 15 pages (excluding references), 5 figures
summary: Accurate LiDAR-camera calibration is essential for robust multi-modal perception. Targetless approaches avoid manual setup but remain limited by the scarcity of discriminative cross-modal features. Recent methods address this by reconstructing the scene within a differentiable model, enabling extrinsic optimization through dense photometric supervision. Among these, 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) has been widely adopted as a geometric proxy that bridges LiDAR and camera within a single differentiable framework. However, since 3DGS was originally designed for novel view synthesis, existing methods tend to prioritize rendering quality, causing the proxy geometry to drift from the true LiDAR structure. We propose a framework that preserves the metric geometry of the Gaussian proxy by aggregating multi-view LiDAR observations for dense depth supervision and blocking photometric gradients from updating the Gaussian spatial parameters. We validate our method on public driving datasets, where it consistently outperforms existing targetless methods in calibration accuracy.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种保留高斯代理度量几何的激光雷达-相机标定方法，通过聚合多视角激光雷达观测进行密集深度监督，并阻止光度梯度更新高斯空间参数，在公开数据集上优于现有无目标方法。
AI.motivation: 现有基于3DGS的无目标标定方法为追求渲染质量，导致代理几何偏离真实的激光雷达结构，影响标定精度。
AI.method: 1) 聚合多视角激光雷达观测进行密集深度监督；2) 阻止光度梯度更新高斯空间参数，保留度量几何。
AI.result: 在公开驾驶数据集上，标定精度 consistently 优于现有无目标方法。
AI.conclusion: 通过保留高斯代理的度量几何，可以有效提升激光雷达-相机标定的准确性。

title: Your Mouse and Eyes Secretly Leak Your Preference: LLM Alignment using Implicit Feedback from Users
summary: To align a Large Language Model (LLM), most existing methods collect explicit human feedback and train a reward model to predict the human preference based on the response text. These existing methods have two key limitations. First, the users rarely provide explicit feedback for LLM responses, which makes the high-quality preference annotation expensive to collect. Second, the methods do not leverage implicit human feedback, which has proven vital to the economic moats of Internet giants. To quantify the value of implicit feedback, we build a new dataset called IFLLM, which collects 1336 multi-turn questions from the 59 Mechanical Turk workers, their mouse trajectories, and eye gazing points to the LLMs' responses from their webcams. IFLLM shows that the users have very diverse types of gazing behavior and mouse trajectories. Our reward model based on the implicit user feedback boosts the accuracy of the text-based reward model from 55% to 64% and nearly triples the relative response quality improvements after applying the DPO to eight LLMs, demonstrating the value of implicit feedback in the wild. Our data collection website, dataset, and codes can be found at https://github.com/themehulpatwari/llm-implicit-feedback/.

AI.tldr: 本文构建了IFLLM数据集（含1336个多轮问答及用户鼠标轨迹、眼动数据），证明隐式反馈（如凝视行为、鼠标轨迹）能显著提升LLM对齐效果，将文本奖励模型准确率从55%提至64%，并在8个LLM上使DPO的相对响应质量提升近三倍。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM对齐方法依赖昂贵的显式人工反馈，且忽视了互联网巨头赖以生存的隐式用户反馈，作者旨在量化隐式反馈的价值。
AI.method: 收集59名MTurk工人的鼠标轨迹和眼动数据构建IFLLM数据集，基于隐式反馈训练奖励模型，结合DPO对8个LLM进行对齐优化。
AI.result: 隐式反馈奖励模型将文本奖励模型准确率从55%提升至64%，应用DPO后8个LLM的相对响应质量提升近三倍。
AI.conclusion: 隐式用户反馈（如注视行为、鼠标轨迹）在LLM对齐中具有显著价值，可有效降低显式标注成本并提升对齐效果。

title: EFIQA: Explainable Fundus Image Quality Assessment via Anatomical Priors
summary: Image quality control is vital for a wide range of downstream applications. Deep learning-based image quality assessment methods typically train classifiers on dataset-specific quality labels, inheriting two limitations: (1) generalization is tied to the labeling criteria of the training set and (2) these methods cannot provide spatial feedback on where the quality is degraded, lacking explainability. In this work, we propose EFIQA, a framework that requires no quality-related supervision and produces spatial quality maps by design. Rather than learning ``what is degradation" from human-annotated labels, EFIQA learns ``what should be there" by leveraging anatomical priors. For fundus photography, we instantiate this as a two-stage approach, by first training an unsupervised anomaly detector via masked anatomical inpainting to identify regions of missing vasculature, and then distilling this prior knowledge into a shallow adapter mapping features of a frozen foundation model to precise quality maps. External-dataset evaluation demonstrates that this label-free approach with minimal adaptation achieves better performance and explainability compared with supervised methods across benchmarks with different quality criteria, highlighting its potential for real-world applications.

AI.tldr: 提出EFIQA框架，无需质量标签即可生成空间质量图，通过解剖先验和掩膜修复实现无监督眼底图像质量评估。
AI.motivation: 现有基于深度学习的图像质量评估方法依赖特定数据集的标签，泛化性受限，且无法提供空间退化位置的可解释性反馈。
AI.method: 两阶段方法：(1) 通过掩膜解剖修复训练无监督异常检测器，识别血管缺失区域；(2) 将先验知识蒸馏到浅层适配器中，将冻结基础模型的特征映射为精确质量图。
AI.result: 在外部数据集评估中，无标签方法经最小适配，在多个不同质量标准的基准上优于有监督方法，同时具备更好的可解释性。
AI.conclusion: EFIQA无需质量标签即可实现优异性能，且提供空间级可解释反馈，在真实应用场景中具有潜力。

title: Beyond Global Replanning: Hierarchical Recovery for Cross-Device Agent Systems
summary: Real-world computer-use tasks often span multiple applications and devices, requiring agents to coordinate heterogeneous environments under dynamic runtime failures. Existing multi-device agent systems support task decomposition and cross-device assignment, but recovery remains largely coarse-grained: when execution fails, they typically retry the same strategy, reassign the subtask, or revise the global plan, without systematically modeling the device-local strategy space. This limits their ability to distinguish failures that can be repaired within the current device from those that require cross-device replanning. We propose \textbf{H-RePlan}, a hierarchical replanning framework for multi-device agents with unified API--CLI--GUI execution. H-RePlan equips each device with interchangeable execution strategies and separates device-local strategy recovery from orchestrator-level global replanning through a compact cross-layer failure abstraction. To evaluate this capability, we introduce \textbf{HeraBench}, a fault-injected benchmark that constructs cross-device workflows over Linux and Android devices and injects strategy- and device-level failures. Experiments show that H-RePlan substantially outperforms single-strategy and coarse-grained multi-device baselines, achieving higher completion, instruction adherence, and perfect-pass rates while reducing the token cost required for reliable end-to-end success. These results demonstrate that scope-aware hierarchical recovery is essential for robust multi-device agent execution.

AI.tldr: 提出H-RePlan，一种分层重规划框架，用于多设备智能体在统一API-CLI-GUI执行中的故障恢复，并通过HeraBench基准测试验证其有效性。
AI.motivation: 现有跨设备智能体系统在任务执行失败时恢复策略粗粒度（如全局重试或重新分配），缺乏对设备本地策略空间的系统建模，无法区分设备内可修复故障与需跨设备重规划的故障。
AI.method: H-RePlan为每个设备配备可互换执行策略，通过紧凑的跨层故障抽象将设备本地策略恢复与编排器级全局重规划相分离。同时构建HeraBench基准，在Linux和Android设备间注入策略级和设备级故障以评估性能。
AI.result: H-RePlan在完成率、指令遵循率和完美通过率上显著优于单策略和粗粒度多设备基线，并降低了端到端成功所需的token成本。
AI.conclusion: 范围感知的分层恢复机制对于实现鲁棒的多设备智能体执行至关重要。

title: QMFOL: Benchmarking Large Language Model Reasoning via Quantifiable Monadic First-Order Logic Test Case Generation
summary:
Large Language Models (LLMs) have made significant progress in reasoning, particularly in deductive reasoning, which is crucial for high-stakes decision-making. As models improve, evaluation benchmarks should evolve to keep pace. However, existing benchmarks lack fine-grained control over logical complexity and struggle to balance semantic diversity with logical consistency.
  To address these issues, we propose QMFOL, an automated framework for generating monadic first-order logic reasoning tasks with quantifiable and controllable complexity. It constructs formal logical structures using conjunction and disjunction patterns, enabling precise control over reasoning depth, width, label types, and distractors. These structures are then translated into natural language via LLMs, with logical consistency ensured through round-trip verification using an external prover. Based on our framework, we build QMFOLBench, a benchmark comprising 2880 instances with 960 configurations across diverse logical and semantic dimensions. Evaluations on six large reasoning models (LRMs) and two LLMs show that performance degrades and computational overhead increases with rising logical complexity. Models perform better on True-labeled tasks than on False or Unknown ones, and exhibit sensitivity to semantic variation. Overall, QMFOL offers a scalable and reliable approach for constructing deductive reasoning benchmarks with controllable complexity, enabling more precise evaluation of reasoning capabilities in modern language models.

AI.tldr: 本文提出QMFOL框架，用于生成可量化控制复杂度的单调一阶逻辑推理任务，并构建了包含2880个实例的基准测试集QMFOLBench，评估结果表明模型性能随逻辑复杂度增加而下降，且对标签类型和语义变化敏感。
AI.motivation: 现有推理基准缺乏对逻辑复杂度的细粒度控制，且在语义多样性与逻辑一致性之间难以平衡。
AI.method: 提出QMFOL框架，通过合取与析取模式构建形式逻辑结构，精确控制推理深度、宽度、标签类型及干扰项，再通过LLM翻译为自然语言，并利用外部证明器进行往返验证确保逻辑一致性。
AI.result: 构建了含2880个实例、960种配置的QMFOLBench；在6个大型推理模型和2个LLM上评估发现：性能随逻辑复杂度增加而下降，计算开销增加，模型在True标签任务上优于False或Unknown任务，且对语义变化敏感。
AI.conclusion: QMFOL提供了一种可扩展且可靠的推理基准构建方法，支持可控的复杂度调节，能够更精确地评估现代语言模型的演绎推理能力。

title: StylisticBias: A Few Human Visual Cues Drive Most Social Biases in MLLMs
comment: Accepted to the non-archival workshops AI4Good and Culture x AI at ICML 2026
summary: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) are increasingly deployed in personally and societally consequential settings, yet the visual cues that shape how these models judge people remain poorly understood. Prior work often compares different (groups of) individuals, making it difficult to separate appearance effects from identity differences. We introduce StylisticBias, a controlled benchmark for evaluating attribute-level social bias in MLLMs. We generate 500 photorealistic base faces and create about 50 single-attribute variations per face, producing about 25K images. This design keeps identity fixed and changes one visual attribute at a time. It lets us measure how specific cues shift model judgments. We evaluate six MLLMs across 25 binary social judgment scenarios. We find that age and body type dominate identity-level effects, while fashion style and other visual cues drive the largest attribute-level shifts. We further find that about 15 attributes account for nearly 80\% of the total variation, showing that bias is concentrated in a small set of visual cues. Sensitivity is strongest in judgments that are semantically aligned with appearance, especially socioeconomic and style-related judgments. We release StylisticBias as a benchmark for fine-grained bias evaluation in multimodal models. Code and dataset: https://github.com/timo-cavelius/StylisticBias and https://hf.co/datasets/shaghayegh/stylistic-bias-dataset.

AI.tldr: 本文提出StylisticBias基准，通过控制单个视觉属性变化（每个身份生成约50种属性变体），系统评估多模态大模型（MLLMs）在25种社会判断场景中的属性级视觉偏见。研究发现年龄和体型主导身份级影响，而时尚风格等视觉线索驱动最大的属性级偏移，约15个属性解释了近80%的偏差变异。
AI.motivation: 现有研究通常比较不同个体或群体，难以区分外貌效应与身份差异。为分离特定视觉属性对模型判断的影响，需要一种控制身份固定、逐属性改变的设计来精确测量属性级社会偏见。
AI.method: 生成500张逼真基础人脸，每张脸创建约50种单属性变体（共约25K图像），保持身份不变、每次只改变一个视觉属性。在6个MLLM上评估25种二元社会判断场景，测量特定视觉线索如何改变模型判断。
AI.result: 年龄和体型主导身份级效应，时尚风格等视觉线索驱动最大的属性级偏移；约15个属性解释了近80%的总变异，偏见集中在少量视觉线索上；敏感性在与社会经济地位和风格相关等与外貌语义对齐的判断中最强。
AI.conclusion: 为多模态模型的细粒度偏见评估提供了可控基准，揭示了偏见在少量视觉属性上的集中分布特征，强调了对特定视觉线索进行针对性去偏的重要性。

title: Thermodynamic Measure of Intelligence
summary: Can intelligence be measured? We propose that intelligence can be defined as the lawful amplification of rare but valid futures: a system increases the probability of outcomes that would be unlikely under passive dynamics but remain admissible under the constraints of the domain. We start with the premise that an intelligent system must model the world and its own place within it. Because the system is part of the world it models, this leads naturally to recursive self-simulation: the system represents futures in which its own actions are part of the trajectory. Our central results give a necessity statement and a conditional near-sufficiency statement connecting this architecture to a precise thermodynamic measure of lawful amplification of rare-valid futures: high rare-valid lift is impossible unless the internal simulation identifies rare-valid futures with high fidelity; conversely, when rare-valid fidelity is high and the simulation contains an effective policy, the achievable lift approaches the actuation-limited optimum. Thus recursive self-simulation is not merely a plausible feature of intelligence but, under the stated assumptions, is necessary and nearly sufficient for high thermodynamic intelligence. The resulting framework makes intelligence measurable on a universal scale, from passive matter and feedback controllers, large language models, and humans as text generators to Maxwell-demon-like information engines.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于热力学的智能测量框架，将智能定义为对稀有但有效未来的合法放大，并证明递归自我模拟是实现高智能的必要且近乎充分的条件。
AI.motivation: 现有智能概念模糊且难以量化，本文旨在通过热力学和信息论视角，建立一种普适的、可测量的智能定义。
AI.method: 从智能系统必须建模世界及自身位置的前提出发，推导出递归自我模拟结构，并建立稀有有效性提升（rare-valid lift）的热力学度量，给出必要性定理和条件近似充分性定理。
AI.result: 高稀有有效性提升需要内部模拟具有高保真度；当保真度高且模拟包含有效策略时，可达的提升接近驱动受限的最优值。因此递归自我模拟是高热力学智能的必要且近乎充分条件。
AI.conclusion: 该框架使智能在从被动物质、反馈控制器、大语言模型到人类文本生成器乃至麦克斯韦妖式信息引擎的广泛系统中均可通用测量。

title: A Multi-Agent system for Multi-Objective constrained optimization
comment: Presented at the 17th Workshop on Optimization and Learning in Multiagent Systems (OptLearnMAS, https://optlearnmas.github.io), co-located with the 25th International Conference on Autonomous Agents and Multiagent Systems (AAMAS 2026)
summary: Many decision-making problems in computing and networking systems can be naturally formulated as cost-minimization problems under performance constraints. In dynamic environments, reinforcement learning (RL) is often used to solve such problems at runtime by embedding both costs and constraint violations into a single scalar reward through weighted penalty terms, following a Lagrangian-inspired formulation. However, in this context the behavior of the learned policy critically depends on the choice of these weights, which are typically selected manually. This makes it difficult to identify an appropriate trade-off between optimizing the primary objective and effectively avoiding constraint violations, particularly in non-stationary environments where their relative importance may change. This paper presents MAMO (Multi-Agent system for Multi-Objective constrained optimization), an approach to tackle this balancing problem through multi-agent RL. MAMO decouples task execution from objective design by formulating the selection of reward weights as a learning problem, providing a !rst step towards more autonomous and robust RL-based solutions for constrained optimization problems in dynamic environments.

AI.tldr: 本文提出MAMO方法，通过多智能体强化学习将奖励权重的选择作为学习问题，从而自动平衡成本最小化与性能约束，解决动态环境中手动调权重的困难。
AI.motivation: 在计算与网络系统的决策问题中，基于强化学习的约束优化通常需要手动设置成本与约束违规之间的惩罚权重，难以在非平稳环境下找到合适的权衡。
AI.method: MAMO采用多智能体强化学习，将任务执行与目标设计解耦，把奖励权重的选择本身作为一个学习问题来处理。
AI.result: MAMO为动态环境下的约束优化问题提供了更自主、更鲁棒的强化学习解决方案。
AI.conclusion: MAMO是向自主权衡优化目标与约束违规迈出的第一步，有助于提升RL在动态环境中解决约束优化问题的能力。

title: Navigating Unreliable Parametric and Contextual Knowledge: Explicit Knowledge Conflict Resolution for LLM Inference
summary: Large language models (LLMs) have achieved strong performance across a wide range of language-based tasks by leveraging both extensive parametric knowledge and in-context learning ability, enabling them to incorporate external information provided in the input prompt. However, the integration of external knowledge can introduce conflicts, not only between the model's internal parametric knowledge and the external information, but also among multiple pieces of external contexts. Existing approaches typically assume that either the model or the provided context is reliable, overlooking the possibility that both sources may contain errors, and avoid conflicts by privileging one source over the other, rather than actively resolving inconsistencies. To address these limitations, we propose a novel framework MACR for LLM knowledge conflict resolution that moves beyond the conventional binary choice paradigm and incorporates an explicit conflict-resolution mechanism based on a multi-agent reasoning approach. Specifically, we first propose an adaptive knowledge assessment and retrieval approach that employs a modified semantic entropy measure to quantify an LLM's confidence in its answer to a given query. Based on this confidence estimation, MACR either externalizes the model's internal knowledge as textual representations or retrieves relevant external knowledge when internal knowledge is insufficient, generating basic contexts for subsequent reasoning. Then we introduce an inductive multi-agent reasoning framework with three specialized agents that, respectively, induce explicit rules, analyze potential conflicts, and resolve inconsistencies across all available contexts. Empirical results demonstrate that MACR significantly outperforms state-of-the-art baselines across benchmarks, while also providing interpretable resolutions of explicit conflicts.

AI.tldr: 提出MACR框架，通过多智能体推理和自适应知识评估，解决大语言模型中内部参数知识与外部上下文信息之间的冲突，超越了传统二元选择范式。
AI.motivation: 现有方法假设模型或上下文有一方可靠，忽略了两者都可能存在错误，且只是回避冲突而非主动解决不一致。
AI.method: 1) 自适应知识评估与检索：用改进的语义熵度量量化模型置信度，据此外化内部知识或检索外部知识；2) 归纳式多智能体推理框架：三个专门智能体分别归纳显式规则、分析潜在冲突、解决所有上下文间的不一致。
AI.result: 在多个基准上显著优于当前最先进基线，同时提供可解释的显式冲突解决方案。
AI.conclusion: MACR通过主动冲突解决机制有效处理知识冲突，证明了超越二元选择范式的可行性。

title: TriFlow: Generating Artist-Like 3D Mesh Topology via Nearest-Vertex Vector Fields
summary: We present TriFlow, a new generative approach for producing compact 3D meshes with artist-like triangle topology directly from input geometry conditions such as signed distance fields. Our key insight is to represent mesh topology as a nearest-vertex vector field (NVF) defined over the surface, where each point encodes its association to the nearest triangle vertex in the local barycentric frame. We train a latent flow-matching model to synthesize this field, enabling topology generation conditioned on the input geometry. To extract a coherent mesh, we cluster surface regions using the generated NVF and guide a constrained quadric error metric (QEM) mesh simplification with topology-aware optimization. This yields output meshes that closely match the input geometry while exhibiting structured, artist-like connectivity. Experiments demonstrate that TriFlow achieves stronger generalization and significantly improved topology quality compared to state-of-the-art learning-based approaches, alongside 90% lower Chamfer Distance and an 8x speedup.

AI.tldr: TriFlow是一种新方法，通过最近邻向量场表示和潜在流匹配模型，生成具有艺术家风格拓扑结构的紧凑3D网格，比现有方法质量更高、速度快8倍。
AI.motivation: 现有生成紧凑3D网格的方法在拓扑质量和泛化能力上存在不足，难以生成具有艺术家风格（结构清晰、规整）的三角拓扑结构。
AI.method: 1) 将网格拓扑表示为定义在表面上的最近邻向量场（NVF），每个点编码其到局部重心坐标系中最近三角形顶点的关联；2) 训练潜在流匹配模型合成该场，实现基于输入几何条件的拓扑生成；3) 利用生成的NVF进行表面区域聚类，并通过拓扑感知优化指导约束二次误差度量（QEM）网格简化，提取连贯网格。
AI.result: 与最先进的基于学习方法相比，TriFlow具有更强的泛化能力、显著提升的拓扑质量，同时查默斯距离降低90%，速度提升8倍。
AI.conclusion: TriFlow能生成与输入几何高度匹配且具有结构化、艺术家风格连接性的输出网格，在拓扑生成任务上优于现有方法。

title: SA-VIS: Sparse frame Annotations for training Video Instance Segmentation
summary: Recent online video instance segmentation (VIS) methods have achieved impressive results, thus becoming the preferred approach to segment instances in videos. Despite the resurgence of impressive single image models, the online (or semi-online) VIS approaches outperform single-image models (e.g., based on SAM) by using long sequences of densely annotated frames during training. However,such a training setup of VIS is expensive in the sense of compute as well as dense annotations required. In order to solve these major flaws, we argue that the effective modeling of the instances and their evolution in videos do not require densely annotated frames. To that end, we propose a simple and effective module, called Past-frames Feature Propagation (PFP) which aggregates low-dimensional features from the image encoder of multiple frames. This simple low-compute module provides tremendous learning capability in using sparse video frame labels for end-to-end training. Combined with a light-weight frame-specific Instance Queries, our Sparse frame Annotation VIS (SA-VIS) significantly improves performance over its baseline. Most interestingly, our simple design that avoids complexities effectively bridges the gap in accuracy between training on sparsely and densely annotated video sequences. This translates to a mere 0.4% drop in performance of SA-VIS when using annotations for only 1/5 of the images in the dataset. Empirically, SA-VIS shows strong improvements over the baseline on YouTube-VIS 2019/2021/2022 and Occluded VIS (OVIS) and an over 1% improvement in AP on the state-of-the-art in a limited annotations scenario.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SA-VIS方法，通过Past-frames Feature Propagation (PFP)模块和轻量级实例查询，仅使用稀疏帧标注即可实现与密集标注相当的视频实例分割性能，在多个数据集上将标注量减少4/5时性能仅下降0.4%。
AI.motivation: 现有在线视频实例分割方法依赖密集标注帧进行训练，计算成本和标注成本高昂，作者旨在降低对密集标注的依赖，同时保持高性能。
AI.method: 提出Past-frames Feature Propagation (PFP)模块，聚合多帧图像编码器的低维特征，结合轻量级帧特定实例查询，构建SA-VIS框架，支持稀疏帧标注的端到端训练。
AI.result: 在YouTube-VIS 2019/2021/2022和OVIS数据集上显著超越基线；仅用1/5标注帧时性能仅下降0.4%；在有限标注场景下AP提升超过1%。
AI.conclusion: 视频中实例及其演化的有效建模不需要密集标注帧，所提简单设计有效缩小了稀疏标注与密集标注之间的性能差距。

title: Leveraging systems' non-linearity to tackle the scarcity of data in the design of Intelligent Fault Diagnosis Systems
summary: Deep Transfer Learning (DTL) allows for the efficient building of Intelligent Fault Diagnosis Systems (IFDS). On the other hand, DTL methods still heavily rely on large amounts of labelled data. Obtaining such an amount of data can be challenging when dealing with machines or structures faults. This document proposes a novel approach to the design of vibration-based IFDS using DTL in condition of strong data scarcity. A periodic multi-excitation level procedure leveraging intrinsic non-linearities of real-world systems is used to produce images that can be conveniently analysed by pre-trained Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) to diagnose faults. A new data visualization method and its augmentation technique are proposed in this paper to tackle the typical lack of data encountered during the design of IFDS. Experimental validation on a railway pantograph structure provides effective support for the proposed method.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于深度迁移学习的新方法，通过周期性多激励水平程序和新型数据可视化与增强技术，在数据极度稀缺条件下构建振动智能故障诊断系统，并在铁路受电弓结构上进行了实验验证。
AI.motivation: 深度迁移学习方法仍然严重依赖大量标注数据，而在机器或结构故障诊断场景中获取如此大量的数据非常困难，因此需要在数据极度稀缺条件下设计有效的智能故障诊断系统。
AI.method: 提出了一种周期性多激励水平程序，利用真实系统的固有非线性特性生成图像，便于预训练卷积神经网络分析；同时提出了新的数据可视化方法及其增强技术，以解决典型的数据匮乏问题。
AI.result: 在铁路受电弓结构上的实验验证有效支持了所提出方法的可行性。
AI.conclusion: 所提出方法能够在数据极度稀缺条件下有效构建基于深度迁移学习的振动智能故障诊断系统。

title: NAMESAKES: Probing Identity Memorization in Text-to-Image Models
summary: Text-to-image (T2I) models generate realistic likenesses of some individuals when prompted with their names, raising privacy concerns. However, distinguishing whether a generated face is memorized or fabricated currently requires ground-truth photos, access to training data, or white-box access to model internals, limiting applicability. We introduce a fully black-box behavioral probe that distinguishes between these regimes while requiring no reference photos or prior knowledge of training data. To benchmark this task, we present the NAMESAKES dataset of over one thousand names and faces of public figures spanning a wide range of fame levels, along with perturbed, less famous names. Experiments on state-of-the-art T2I models show that our probe substantially predicts identity memorization and separates memorized from unrecognized names, with further insights into differences across model families.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种黑盒行为探测方法，无需参考照片或训练数据，即可区分T2I模型生成的人脸是记忆还是虚构，并构建了NAMESAKES数据集进行验证。
AI.motivation: 现有方法需要真实照片、训练数据或模型内部信息才能判断生成人脸是否被记忆，限制了实际应用场景。
AI.method: 设计了完全黑盒的行为探测方法，并构建了包含上千个不同知名度公众人物名字的NAMESAKES数据集。
AI.result: 该方法能有效预测身份记忆行为，区分记忆名字与未识别名字，并揭示不同模型家族间的差异。
AI.conclusion: 提出的黑盒探测方法无需任何先验知识即可有效区分记忆与虚构生成，具有广泛的应用前景。

title: SoftSkill: Behavioral Compression for Contextual Adaptation
summary: Agent skills are commonly deployed as natural-language Markdown files that encode answer policies, evidence-use habits, and task procedures. These files are readable and portable, but they are consumed indirectly: for each task instance, a frozen language model must translate a long textual artifact into generation-time behavior. This paper asks whether a natural-language skill can instead initialize a compact continuous context object, refined by a trainable soft delta while the base model remains frozen. We propose SoftSkill, a frozen-backbone method that tunes such soft skills with next-token prediction and deploys them as latent behavioral priors at inference time. In our main single-round setting, a length-32 SoftSkill prefix on Qwen3.5-4B improves over no-skill prompting by 8.3 points on SearchQA, 42.1 points on LiveMath, and 1.3 points on DocVQA. Relative to SkillOpt, SoftSkill improves accuracy by 5.2 points on SearchQA and 12.5 points on LiveMath, while replacing hundreds to thousands of Markdown skill tokens with a few virtual tokens. We further study agentic execution as a harder boundary case, where sparse trajectory imitation provides useful signal but does not yet robustly compress long-horizon procedural behavior. More broadly, the results suggest that some task skills are better treated not as additional Markdown to be reinterpreted at inference time, but as compact latent controls over how a frozen model enters the task.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SoftSkill方法，用少量连续虚拟标记（soft skill）替代自然语言Markdown技能文件，在不修改基座模型参数的前提下，通过可训练的软增量优化来编码任务行为先验，在多个任务上取得显著提升。
AI.motivation: 传统Markdown技能文件虽然可读可移植，但需冻结语言模型在每个任务实例中重新解读冗长文本，效率低下且难以压缩。本文探索是否能用紧凑的连续上下文对象替代自然语言技能，使其可训练、可复用。
AI.method: SoftSkill方法：构造长度为32的连续虚拟标记（soft skill）作为前缀，基座模型（Qwen3.5-4B）保持冻结，仅通过下一个标记预测任务训练软增量（soft delta），推理时作为潜在行为先验注入模型。
AI.result: 在SearchQA上提升8.3分，LiveMath提升42.1分，DocVQA提升1.3分；相比SkillOpt方法，SearchQA提升5.2分，LiveMath提升12.5分，用少量虚拟标记替代成百上千的Markdown标记。
AI.conclusion: 任务技能更适合作为紧凑的潜在控制信号（latent controls）而非需在推理时重新解读的Markdown文本，但长程程序行为的鲁棒压缩仍面临挑战，尤其在代理执行场景下。

title: Automating SKILL.md Generation for Computer-Using Agents via Interaction Trajectory Mining
summary: Explicit skill libraries make computer-using agents easier to inspect, but it remains unclear whether such libraries can be mined from interaction data in a way that improves downstream policies. We study this question through a three-stage pipeline that segments GUI trajectories, clusters segments into candidate skills, and trains a skill-aware policy from the resulting annotations. The mined clusters are readable on the source benchmark: five of eight clusters have at least 0.95 purity against InteraSkill Workflows labels. However, readability does not imply transfer. GRPO improves IW skill-step accuracy only from 18.5\% to 20.5\%, leaves BrowseComp+ essentially unchanged, and underperforms trivial frequency priors on key source-domain metrics. We therefore present the method as a diagnostic study: trajectory mining can expose inspectable skill structure, but the current boundary detector, orderless segment representation, and offline reward model are insufficient for reliable cross-domain policy improvement.

AI.tldr: 本文研究能否从交互数据中挖掘显式技能库来提升计算机操作代理的决策能力。通过三阶段流程（分割GUI轨迹、聚类候选技能、训练技能感知策略），发现虽然聚类结果可读性高（5/8聚类纯度≥0.95），但下游策略提升有限（技能准确率仅从18.5%提升至20.5%），说明可读性不等于可迁移性。作者将其作为诊断性研究，指出当前边界检测器、无序段表示和离线奖励模型不足以实现可靠的跨域策略改进。
AI.motivation: 探究能否从交互数据中挖掘显式技能库，使其既具备可解释性（便于人类检查），又能实际提升下游计算机操作代理的策略性能。
AI.method: 采用三阶段流水线：1）分割GUI操作轨迹；2）将片段聚类为候选技能；3）基于聚类标注训练技能感知策略。使用InteraSkill Workflows基准测试聚类纯度，并通过GRPO优化评估技能步骤准确率。
AI.result: 聚类可读性高（5/8聚类纯度≥0.95），但策略改进微弱：IW技能步骤准确率仅从18.5%升至20.5%，BrowseComp+指标几乎无变化，且在关键源域指标上不如简单的频率先验。
AI.conclusion: 轨迹挖掘可以暴露出可检查的技能结构，但当前的方法组件（边界检测器、无序段表示、离线奖励模型）不足以支持可靠的跨域策略改进。该方法应被视为诊断性研究，揭示可读性与可迁移性之间的鸿沟。

title: Evaluating and Enhancing Negation Comprehension in Remote Sensing MLLMs
summary: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have demonstrated remarkable success in various Remote Sensing (RS) tasks. However, their ability to comprehend negation remains underexplored, limiting deployment in real-world applications where models must explicitly identify what is false or absent, e.g., emergency responders need to locate non-flooded routes for evacuation. To comprehensively study this limitation, we introduce RS-Neg, the first benchmark to evaluate negation understanding across region-level to scene-level tasks. Specifically, we design an automated data generation pipeline for RS imagery, using LLMs to synthesize diverse negation queries, and introduce a dynamic visual focus module for verification. Our evaluation reveals that advanced RS MLLMs struggle with negation, exhibiting hallucinations and substantial performance degradation. To close this gap, we propose NeFo, a novel test-time learning method that explicitly incorporates the logical role of negation into the model optimization. Remarkably, using about 5\% unlabeled test samples, NeFo significantly improves the negation understanding of models and shows strong generalization to unseen tasks. Code and data will be released upon acceptance.

AI.tldr: MLLM在遥感领域难以理解否定语义，本文提出RS-Neg基准和NeFo方法，仅用5%未标注测试样本即可显著提升模型对否定的理解能力。
AI.motivation: 现有的多模态大模型在遥感任务中表现优异，但其对否定语义（如“非洪水区域”）的理解能力未被充分探索，这限制了实际部署（如应急救援中寻找非淹没路线）。
AI.method: 1) 构建RS-Neg基准，通过LLM自动生成多样化否定查询，并设计动态视觉聚焦模块进行验证；2) 提出NeFo方法，在测试时将否定的逻辑角色显式融入模型优化中。
AI.result: 现有遥感MLLM在否定理解上表现不佳，出现幻觉和性能大幅下降；NeFo仅用约5%未标注测试样本即可显著提升否定理解能力，并展现出对未见任务的强泛化性。
AI.conclusion: RS-Neg揭示了MLLM在遥感否定理解上的缺陷，NeFo作为一种轻量级测试时学习方法，能有效弥补这一差距，有望推动MLLM在关键遥感场景中的可靠应用。

title: Rethinking Shrinkage Bias in LLM FP4 Pretraining: Geometric Origin, Systemic Impact, and UFP4 Recipe
summary: FP4 training promises substantial reductions in memory and computation cost for LLM pretraining, yet current FP4 hardware paths and recipes, including NVIDIA Blackwell/Rubin-class systems and AMD MI350-series GPUs, remain centered on E2M1 data elements. In this study, we identify a fundamental limitation of that choice: non-uniform formats such as E2M1 inherently suffer from Shrinkage Bias, a systematic negative rounding error caused by the geometric asymmetry of their representable bins. We show that this bias accumulates multiplicatively across layers and is amplified by the Random Hadamard Transform (RHT), providing a unified explanation for the training instability observed in existing E2M1-based FP4 recipes. In contrast, uniform grids (E1M2/INT4) bypass this grid-geometry error and better convert the improved bucket utilization from RHT into higher quantization quality. Based on this finding, we propose UFP4, a uniform 4-bit training recipe that applies RHT to all three training GEMMs while restricting stochastic rounding to dY alone. On Dense 1.5B, MoE 7.9B, and MoE 124B long-run pretraining, UFP4 consistently achieves lower BF16-relative loss degradation than strong E2M1-based baselines, supported by scaling-law analysis and ablation studies. Our results suggest that future accelerators should support E1M2/INT4-style uniform 4-bit grids as first-class training primitives alongside E2M1.

AI.tldr: 本文发现E2M1格式的FP4训练存在“收缩偏差”（Shrinkage Bias），即非均匀格式的几何不对称性导致系统性负向舍入误差，该误差会乘性累积并被随机哈达玛变换放大。相比之下，均匀格式（E1M2/INT4）可规避此问题。作者提出UFP4训练方案，在三个训练GEMM上应用RHT并仅对dY使用随机舍入，在1.5B Dense、7.9B/124B MoE模型上取得优于E2M1基线的结果。
AI.motivation: 现有FP4硬件方案（如NVIDIA Blackwell/Rubin、AMD MI350）仍围绕E2M1格式设计，但基于E2M1的FP4训练存在不稳定性问题，其根本原因尚未被明确揭示。本文旨在探究E2M1格式的根本缺陷并提出更优的4-bit训练方案。
AI.method: 提出UFP4（Uniform FP4）训练方案：1）采用均匀网格格式（E1M2/INT4）；2）对三个训练GEMM均应用随机哈达玛变换（RHT）；3）仅对dY梯度使用随机舍入。通过理论分析证明E2M1的“收缩偏差”及其与RHT的交互作用，并在多规模模型上验证。
AI.result: 在Dense 1.5B、MoE 7.9B和MoE 124B的长程预训练中，UFP4在BF16相对损失退化上持续优于强E2M1基线，并通过缩放律分析和消融实验证实了方法的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 未来加速器应将E1M2/INT4风格的均匀4-bit网格作为一等训练原语，与E2M1并列支持，以提升FP4训练的稳定性和精度。

title: Distill Once, Adapt Life-Long: Exploring Dataset Distillation for Continual Test-Time Adaptation
summary: Continual Test-Time Adaptation (CTTA) aims to maintain model performance under evolving target domains by adapting online without labeled data. However, practical deployments often cannot retain the source dataset due to privacy or licensing constraints, and purely source-free CTTA methods tend to become unstable under long-term distribution shift, suffering from compounding self-training errors and catastrophic forgetting. We introduce DO-ALL (Distill Once, Adapt Life-Long), a plug-and-play framework that revisits source information in a compact and privacy-conscious form via Dataset Distillation (DD). Before deployment, DO-ALL performs DD to produce a small set of synthetic distilled anchors that summarize the source distribution. During adaptation, each target sample is matched with its most semantically aligned anchor, which provides a stable reference for various CTTA via source replay, representation alignment, and manifold-smoothing regularization. DO-ALL can be seamlessly integrated into existing CTTA algorithms, consistently improving long-term robustness across CIFAR100-C, ImageNet-C, and the CCC benchmark. This demonstrates the potential of leveraging DD to enable stable and continuous adaptation without retaining raw source data. The code is available at https://github.com/blue-531/DOALL.

AI.tldr: 提出DO-ALL框架，通过数据集蒸馏生成紧凑的合成锚点来替代原始源数据，在持续测试时自适应中实现长期稳定的模型适应，无需保留原始源数据。
AI.motivation: 现有源自由的CTTA方法在长期分布偏移下会累积自训练错误和灾难性遗忘，而实际部署中常因隐私或许可限制无法保留源数据集。
AI.method: 部署前用数据集蒸馏生成少量合成蒸馏锚点；适应时为目标样本匹配最语义对齐的锚点，通过源回放、表示对齐和流形平滑正则化实现稳定适应。
AI.result: 在CIFAR100-C、ImageNet-C和CCC基准上，DO-ALL可无缝集成到现有CTTA算法中，一致提升长期鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: 数据集蒸馏能够在不保留原始源数据的前提下，为持续测试时自适应提供稳定支持，实现长期稳定的连续适应。

title: Evaluation of Image Matching for Art Skills Assessment
summary: While some individuals possess a natural talent for drawing, mastering this skill requires dedicated training and practice. Determining one's skill in the art of drawing requires proper comprehensive assessment. In this paper, we propose a method to measure drawing skill by by matching the hand-drawn image with the original template. Existing techniques often involve complex processes. However, advancements in computer vision allow us to train computers to perform these comparisons at a human-like level, thereby resolving the tedious and overwhelming traditional process. Using computer vision applications, determining image similarity involves identifying the level of similarities in an image with a reference image. We have implemented and analyzed the SIFT feature and Siamese network to measure image similarity. Our results indicate that it is feasible to assess art skill levels. Through feature analysis, we found that SIFT-based key point matching provides a more effective means of detecting drawing skills.

AI.tldr: 本文提出利用计算机视觉技术（SIFT特征和Siamese网络）通过比对模板与手绘图像来评估绘画技能水平，实验表明基于SIFT的关键点匹配方法更有效。
AI.motivation: 传统绘画技能评估依赖人工，过程繁琐且主观性强，需要一种自动化、客观的评估方法。
AI.method: 使用SIFT特征匹配和Siamese网络两种方法，将手绘图像与原始模板进行相似度比对，从而量化绘画技能水平。
AI.result: SIFT特征的关键点匹配方法比Siamese网络更有效地检测绘画技能水平。
AI.conclusion: 利用计算机视觉技术自动评估绘画技能是可行的，其中SIFT方法表现更优。

title: What Do Safety-Aligned LLMs Learn From Mixed Compliance Demonstrations?
summary: Prior work has shown that in-context demonstrations can jailbreak language models, but it remains unclear how models interpret different types of compliance demonstrations. We study this by mixing benign compliance demonstrations (non-harmful request, helpful response) with harmful compliance demonstrations (harmful request, helpful response) and testing three hypotheses about how demonstration composition drives harmful compliance. Across four models, we find that benign and harmful demonstrations are not interchangeable: benign demonstrations can either reduce or increase harmful compliance depending on the model. We further show that preference optimization is the critical training stage that prevents benign demonstrations from increasing harmful compliance, that demonstration ordering exhibits strong recency bias, and that models differ in how refusal interacts with in-context learning: some adopt demonstrated formatting even when refusing, while others override all in-context signals upon refusal. Taken together, this work moves beyond showing that demonstration-based jailbreaking works to characterizing how it works: what models extract from compliance demonstrations depends on demonstration content, ordering, and training methodology.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过混合良性与有害的顺从示例，探究了上下文示范如何影响语言模型的顺从行为，发现示范内容、顺序和训练方式共同决定了模型的解读方式。
AI.motivation: 已有工作表明上下文示范可以越狱语言模型，但模型如何理解不同类型的顺从示范尚不清楚。
AI.method: 混合良性顺从示范（无害请求+有用响应）与有害顺从示范（有害请求+有用响应），测试三种关于示范组成如何驱动有害顺从的假设。
AI.result: 良性和有害示范不可互换；良性示范可能减少或增加有害顺从取决于模型；偏好优化是关键训练阶段；示范顺序存在强烈近因偏差；模型在拒绝与上下文学习交互方面存在差异。
AI.conclusion: 模型从顺从示范中提取什么取决于示范内容、顺序和训练方法，超越"示范越狱可行"的层面，揭示了其内在机制。

title: Multi-LCB: Extending LiveCodeBench to Multiple Programming Languages
summary:
LiveCodeBench (LCB) has recently become a widely adopted benchmark for evaluating large language models (LLMs) on code-generation tasks. By curating competitive programming problems, constantly adding fresh problems to the set, and filtering them by release dates, LCB provides contamination-aware evaluation and offers a holistic view of coding capability. However, LCB remains restricted to Python, leaving open the question of whether LLMs can generalize across the diverse programming languages required in real-world software engineering.
  We introduce Multi-LCB, a benchmark for evaluating LLMs across twelve programming languages, including Python. Multi-LCB transforms Python tasks from the LCB dataset into equivalent tasks in other languages while preserving LCB's contamination controls and evaluation protocol. Because it is fully compatible with the original LCB format, Multi-LCB will automatically track future LCB updates, enabling systematic assessment of cross-language code generation competence and requiring models to sustain performance well beyond Python.
  We evaluated 24 LLMs for instruction and reasoning on Multi-LCB, uncovering evidence of Python overfitting, language-specific contamination, and substantial disparities in multilingual performance. Our results establish Multi-LCB as a rigorous new benchmark for multi-programming-language code evaluation, directly addressing LCB's primary limitation and exposing critical gaps in current LLM capabilities.

AI.tldr: Multi-LCB是在LCB基础上扩展的跨12种编程语言的代码生成基准，揭示了当前LLM存在Python过拟合、语言特定污染和多语言性能差异等问题。
AI.motivation: LCB仅支持Python，无法评估LLM在真实软件工程中多编程语言泛化能力，因此需要构建跨语言代码生成基准。
AI.method: 将LCB数据集的Python任务转化为12种编程语言的等价任务，保留LCB的污染控制与评估协议，并与原始LCB格式完全兼容以自动追踪未来更新。
AI.result: 对24个LLM（指令型与推理型）进行评估，发现了Python过拟合、语言特定污染以及多语言性能的显著差异。
AI.conclusion: Multi-LCB作为新的多语言代码评估基准，直接解决了LCB的主要局限，暴露了当前LLM在跨语言代码生成方面的关键短板。

title: Cinematic Compositing Using Character-Environment-Harmonized Video Generation Models
summary: Cinematic compositing aims to integrate green-screen characters into novel environments while maintaining physical and photometric realism. Previous methods often fail to capture the complex bidirectional interactions between characters and their surroundings, which we characterize as Character-to-Environment (C2E) physical interaction and Environment-to-Character (E2C) lighting harmonization. To address this, we propose an end-to-end video diffusion framework that jointly models C2E and E2C interactions, specifically handling the challenges of interactive props. Our approach introduces a tri-mask-guided architecture with RGB-D joint denoising to ensure physically consistent interactions among the character, props, and environment. We further develop an efficient prior-driven data curation pipeline to construct high-quality relighting pairs without expensive rendering. Finally, a reference-conditioned mechanism enables controllable environment synthesis and precise prop replacement. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our framework significantly outperforms existing methods in cinematic-quality dynamic video compositing.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种端到端的视频扩散框架，通过三掩码引导架构和RGB-D联合去噪，实现角色与环境的双向物理交互（C2E）和光照协调（E2C），显著提升电影级动态视频合成质量。
AI.motivation: 现有方法无法捕捉角色与环境之间的复杂双向交互（C2E物理交互与E2C光照协调），尤其缺乏对交互道具的处理能力。
AI.method: 提出三掩码引导架构+RGB-D联合去噪实现角色、道具、环境的一致性交互；构建基于先验的高效数据整理管线生成高质量重光照数据对；引入参考条件机制控制环境合成与道具替换。
AI.result: 在电影级动态视频合成任务中显著优于现有方法。
AI.conclusion: 该框架有效解决了角色与环境双向交互问题，为视频合成领域提供了新的解决方案。

title: BAFIS: Dataset + Framework to assess occupational Bias and Human Preference in modern Text-to-image Models
comment: Accepted at the IEEE Winter Conference on Applications of Computer Vision, WACV 2026
summary: Generative artificial intelligence has the potential to improve productivity and transform the production of creative content. However, existing research indicates that image generation models are significantly influenced by biases. This work investigates the inherent biases and language-induced biases present in text-to-image models within the context of occupation-related image generation, complementing established metrics with human preference feedback. We present a comprehensive evaluation of five current text-to-image models: Midjourney v6.1, Stable Diffusion 3 Medium, DALL-E 3, Playground v2.5, and FLUX.1-dev , focusing on gender and ethnicity bias, image quality, and prompt alignment. To facilitate this evaluation, we developed the "Battle-Arena for Fair Image Synthesis" (BAFIS), a platform designed to collect human feedback on bias in generated images. Furthermore, we created a dataset comprising 21,140 synthetic images generated using multilingual prompts, which serves as a basis for our analysis. We further place our results within a broader social context by comparing them to official statistics from the German Federal Employment Agency. Our findings reveal systematic biases in text-to-image models, with established evaluation metrics in partial correlation with subjective user ratings. Thus, our research emphasizes the need for including human preferences to develop fairer and more inclusive text-to-image models.

AI.tldr: 本文系统评估了五种主流文生图模型（Midjourney v6.1, Stable Diffusion 3 Medium, DALL-E 3, Playground v2.5, FLUX.1-dev）在职业图像生成中的性别和种族偏见，并通过构建BAFIS平台收集人类偏好反馈，发现现有评估指标与用户主观评价仅部分相关，强调引入人类反馈对开发更公平模型的重要性。
AI.motivation: 现有研究表明文生图模型存在显著偏见，但缺乏结合人类偏好反馈的系统性评估。作者希望通过构建带有人类反馈的评估框架，揭示模型偏见并推动更公平的生成模型开发。
AI.method: 1) 构建BAFIS平台收集人类对生成图像偏见的反馈；2) 创建包含21,140张多语言提示生成图像的合成数据集；3) 评估五种模型在性别偏见、种族偏见、图像质量和提示对齐四个维度上的表现；4) 将结果与德国联邦就业局的官方统计数据进行社会背景对比。
AI.result: 发现所有五种模型均存在系统性偏见；现有客观评估指标与用户主观评分仅呈现部分相关性。
AI.conclusion: 开发更公平的文生图模型必须纳入人类偏好反馈，仅依赖传统评估指标不足以全面衡量和消除模型偏见。

title: DeepSWIP: Quotient-WMC Counterfactuals for Neural Probabilistic Logic Programs
summary: Neurosymbolic systems such as DeepProbLog combine neural perception with probabilistic logic, but standard inference is associational. Counterfactual reasoning additionally requires a causal semantics for interventions and evidence. We introduce DeepSWIP, a single-world counterfactual semantics for DeepProbLog programs. Using neural materialization, we reduce fixed-context neural predicates to ordinary ProbLog choices, apply Single World Intervention Programs (SWIPs), and compute counterfactuals by weighted model counting (WMC) over a single transformed program. Under finite grounding and unique-supported-model assumptions, DeepSWIP is exact relative to the learned materialized FCM. The standard quotient-WMC form of ProbLog conditionals identifies active neural probabilities and explains intervention cleaning, calibration sensitivity, and rare-evidence instability. Experiments on MPI3D confirm the transformation against a DeepTwin construction against 12,000 queries, as predicted and a 2.14$\times$ inference speedup from avoiding the Twin's endogenous duplication. A SUMO HOV experiment shows that neural calibration degradation biases plug-in estimates, while a correctly scoped randomized-policy AIPW estimator removes most first-order bias for population mean and ATE estimands. Code is at https://github.com/saibib/deep_SWIP.

AI.tldr: 本文提出DeepSWIP，一种用于DeepProbLog程序的单世界反事实推理语义，通过神经物化将反事实推理转化为加权模型计数，实验证明其精确性、速度提升及校准偏差校正效果。
AI.motivation: 现有的神经符号系统（如DeepProbLog）仅支持关联推理，缺乏反事实推理所需的因果语义，无法回答干预和证据条件下的反事实问题。
AI.method: 1) 提出单世界反事实语义（DeepSWIP）；2) 通过神经物化将固定上下文的神经谓词转化为普通ProbLog选择；3) 应用单世界干预程序（SWIP）；4) 通过加权模型计数（WMC）在单个变换后的程序上计算反事实。
AI.result: 1) 在MPI3D上对12,000个查询验证了变换的精确性；2) 相比DeepTwin方法获得2.14倍推理加速；3) SUMO HOV实验表明神经校准退化会偏置插件估计，而正确范围的随机策略AIPW估计器能消除大部分一阶偏差。
AI.conclusion: DeepSWIP为神经符号系统提供了精确的反事实推理能力，同时通过避免孪生网络的冗余计算提升了效率，并能识别和校正神经概率校准偏差对因果估计的影响。

title: SPOT-E: Test-Time Entropy Shaping with Visual Spotlights for Frozen VLMs
summary: Vision-language models (VLMs) often underperform on evidence intensive tasks because decisive visual evidence are small, localized, and easy to overlook, leading to failures in evidence readout even when high-level reasoning is intact. Prior inference-time visual interventions can improve grounding without retraining, but they are largely open-loop and lack a mechanism to verify whether highlighted evidence is actually used. We study answer-span prediction entropy as a model-internal feedback signal and show that naive entropy minimization is ambiguous, since low entropy may arise from evidence-grounded confidence or shortcut collapse. To resolve this ambiguity, we introduce low-entropy anchors and an entropy-shaping objective that reduces answer uncertainty while preserving baseline high-confidence tokens. We instantiate this principle in SPOT-E, a plug-and-play test-time method that produces question-conditioned spotlights, optimized per instance via light-weight tuning based on Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO). Across all benchmarks and different VLM families, SPOT-E yields consistent gains and improved robustness under visual corruptions. Code is publicly available at: \url{https://github.com/YinBo0927/SPOT-E}

AI.tldr: SPOT-E是一种即插即用的测试时方法，通过基于GRPO的低熵锚点和熵整形目标优化视觉关注区域，提升视觉语言模型在证据密集型任务中的表现。
AI.motivation: 现有视觉语言模型在处理证据密集型任务时，容易忽略微小、局部的关键视觉证据，导致证据读取失败。尽管已有推理时的视觉干预方法，但缺乏验证高亮证据是否被实际利用的闭环机制。
AI.method: 提出低熵锚点和熵整形目标，利用答案跨度预测熵作为模型内部反馈信号，通过GRPO进行逐实例的轻量级优化，生成问题条件化的视觉"聚光灯"。
AI.result: 在多个基准测试和不同VLM家族上，SPOT-E均取得一致性能提升，并在视觉损坏条件下表现出更强的鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: SPOT-E通过解决熵最小化的歧义问题，实现了有效的测试时视觉干预，验证了利用模型内部反馈信号指导视觉证据提取的可行性。

title: LedgerAgent: Structured State for Policy-Adherent Tool-Calling Agents
summary: Policy-adherent tool-calling agents in customer-service domains must maintain task states across turns while calling tools and obeying domain policies. Task states consist of relevant facts, identifiers, constraints, and conditions observed through user interaction and tool calls. In standard agents, task states are not represented separately. Observations, tool returns, and policy instructions are placed in the prompt, leaving agents to reconstruct the relevant states from the prompt each time they decide what to do next. This design makes state management implicit, creating two common failure modes. An agent may retrieve the right facts but later ground its decision in stale, missing, or incorrect information; and a syntactically valid tool call may still violate a domain policy that depends on the current task state. We introduce \textsc{LedgerAgent}, an inference-time method for tool-calling agents that maintains observed task states in a separate ledger and renders the states into the prompt. The ledger is also used to check state-dependent policy constraints before environment-changing tool calls are executed, blocking policy violations. Across four customer-service domains and a mixed panel of open- and closed-weight models, \textsc{LedgerAgent} improves average pass\textasciicircum{}k over a standard prompt-based tool-calling approach, with the largest gains under stricter multi-trial consistency metrics.

AI.tldr: 本文提出LedgerAgent方法，通过将任务状态维护在独立分类账中并渲染到提示中，在工具调用前检查状态相关策略约束，从而显著提升客服领域工具调用代理的策略合规性和状态一致性。
AI.motivation: 现有工具调用代理将任务状态隐式放在提示中，导致两种常见失败：代理可能基于过时/错误信息做决策，或工具调用违反依赖当前状态的领域策略。
AI.method: LedgerAgent在推理时维护独立的分类账记录观察到的任务状态，将状态渲染到提示中，并在执行改变环境的工具调用前检查状态相关的策略约束。
AI.result: 在四个客服领域及多种开源/闭源模型上，LedgerAgent相比标准提示式工具调用方法平均提升了pass@k指标，在更严格的多轮一致性指标下提升最明显。
AI.conclusion: 显式维护任务状态并进行策略约束检查能有效减少状态管理隐式化带来的错误，提升工具调用代理的可靠性和策略合规性。

title: Toward Calibrated Mixture-of-Experts Under Distribution Shift
summary: Calibration aligns a model's predictive uncertainty with the frequencies of its empirical outcomes and is important for understanding and trusting reported probabilities. Recent work shows that enforcing calibration at the level of individual predictors can improve ensemble accuracy and calibration, with mixture-of-experts (MoE) models showing strong empirical improvements in particular; however, the conditions under which calibration helps MoE are not well understood. In this work, we study how MoE models behave under distribution shift, focusing on how routing mechanisms interact with expert-level calibration. We show that expert calibration is sufficient to ensure calibration of the overall model under a broad class of distribution shifts in hard-routed models, but is insufficient for calibrating soft-routed models. To address this, we propose an adversarial reweighting that penalizes calibration errors of the routed aggregate under distribution shift, and we demonstrate that it improves the accuracy-calibration tradeoff both on average and on difficult subsets of the data, across model classes, prediction tasks, and distribution shifts.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了在分布偏移下，专家级校准（Expert-level Calibration）如何影响混合专家模型（MoE）的整体校准性能，发现硬路由模型下专家校准足以保证整体校准，但软路由模型不足，并提出了一种对抗性重加权方法以改善校准-准确率权衡。
AI.motivation: 现有研究表明，对个体预测器进行校准可以提升集成模型和混合专家模型的准确率与校准性能，但校准在何种条件下有助于MoE模型尚不明确。本文旨在深入理解分布偏移下路由机制与专家级校准之间的交互作用。
AI.method: 1. 理论分析硬路由和软路由MoE模型在分布偏移下的校准行为；2. 证明硬路由模型下专家校准足以保证整体校准，而软路由模型则不足；3. 提出一种对抗性重加权方法，通过惩罚分布偏移下路由聚合结果的校准误差来改善校准-准确率权衡。
AI.result: 硬路由MoE中，专家级校准在多种分布偏移下足以保证整体模型校准；软路由MoE中专家校准不足以保证整体校准；提出的对抗性重加权方法在多个模型类别、预测任务和分布偏移场景下，均能改善准确率-校准权衡，特别是在困难数据子集上效果显著。
AI.conclusion: 专家级校准对MoE模型在分布偏移下的表现有重要影响，但不同路由机制下效果不同。对抗性重加权方法能有效提升软路由MoE模型的校准性能，对未来可信赖机器学习系统的设计具有指导意义。

title: CMDS-AD: Cross-Modal Dual-Stream Decoupling for Few-Shot Anomaly Detection
summary: Few-shot anomaly detection remains challenging due to limited training data. Multi-modal anomaly detection (MAD) offers a viable solution, leveraging 3D geometric cues to enrich 2D RGB representations and compensate for this scarcity. However, existing MAD methods apply spatially uniform feature processing, conflating stable macroscopic structures with high-frequency localized defect signals, exacerbating cross-modal misalignment and inflating false-positive rates. To overcome this, we present CMDS-AD, a Cross-Modal Dual-Stream Anomaly Detection framework. A LoRA-guided diffusion model generates diverse RGB samples to mitigate extreme data scarcity. For 3D normal augmentation, we employ a pre-trained diffusion model as a normal estimator. Crucially, this estimator inherently acts as a non-linear low-pass filter, directly extracting low-frequency normal representations from RGB inputs. This establishes an auxiliary estimated stream of purely low-frequency information, anchoring robust structural templates and assisting the uncompressed real stream, containing coupled high- and low-frequency components, to precisely isolate micro-defects. A Coordinate-Aware Hierarchical Feature Mapper adaptively aligns cross-modal semantics, while a multiplicative scoring mechanism filters modality-specific noise. Under the extreme 1-shot setting, CMDS-AD achieves absolute performance gains of 5.7% (I-AUROC) and 2.0% (AUPRO) on MVTec 3D-AD, alongside 7.7% and 5.6% improvements on EyeCandies, establishing a new state-of-the-art.

AI.tldr: CMDS-AD提出了一种跨模态双流异常检测框架，通过LoRA引导的扩散模型进行RGB数据增强，并利用预训练扩散模型作为3D法向估计器（非线性低通滤波器）分离低频正常结构与高频缺陷信号，结合坐标感知分层特征映射器和乘法评分机制，在1-shot设定下显著提升了多模态异常检测性能。
AI.motivation: 现有少样本异常检测面临数据稀缺问题，多模态方法虽能利用3D几何信息增强2D表示，但现有方法对特征进行空间均匀处理，混淆了稳定的宏观结构与高频局部缺陷信号，导致跨模态对齐不良和误报率升高。
AI.method: 1) LoRA引导的扩散模型生成多样RGB样本缓解数据稀缺；2) 预训练扩散模型作为法向估计器（非线性低通滤波器），从RGB输入中提取低频正常表示，构建辅助估计流；3) 未压缩的真实流保留高低频耦合信息；4) 坐标感知分层特征映射器对齐跨模态语义；5) 乘法评分机制过滤模态特定噪声。
AI.result: 在1-shot设定下，MVTec 3D-AD上I-AUROC提升5.7%，AUPRO提升2.0%；EyeCandies上分别提升7.7%和5.6%，达到新SOTA。
AI.conclusion: 通过双流架构有效解耦高低频信息，结合数据增强和对齐机制，显著提升了少样本多模态异常检测的精度和鲁棒性。

title: CUPID: Reconstructing UV Texture Maps for Interpretable Person-of-Interest Deepfake Detection
summary: Deepfakes targeting a high-profile individual, known as Person-of-Interest (POI), are a threat to modern democracies and societies. Current POI deepfake detection methods still struggle to combine robustness to post-processing, efficiency and interpretability, focal aspects of modern deepfake detectors. In this paper we propose CUPID, a POI video deepfake detector that combines UV texture maps, a facial appearance representation derived from 3D face reconstructions, with the representation learning capabilities of the Masked Autoencoder (MAE). Our method does not require any deepfake videos in its training phase. Moreover, it does not even require to include a specific POI in the training set: the combination of UV texture maps extracted from real video frames and the MAE context-guided reconstruction yields a latent space that captures rich and discriminative facial features also for identities unseen during training. In the testing phase, the embeddings extracted from a query video depicting the POI can be matched against pristine reference videos to assess the video authenticity. Furthermore, operating in the UV space naturally provides an additional layer of interpretability. Specifically, we can extract decoded residual maps that highlight which facial regions of a test video deviate most from the identity representation of the corresponding POI. Experiments on four deepfake datasets show that CUPID outperforms current state of the art on most datasets and achieves the best overall robustness against strong downscaling and compression, providing also substantially faster inference. Our experimental code will be released at https://github.com/polimi-ispl/CUPID.

AI.tldr: CUPID是一种针对特定人物（POI）的深度伪造视频检测方法，它结合UV纹理图与掩码自编码器（MAE），无需深度伪造视频参与训练，在多个数据集上达到SOTA性能，并具备鲁棒性、高效性和可解释性。
AI.motivation: 针对高知名度人物的深度伪造视频对现代民主社会构成威胁，现有POI深度伪造检测方法在鲁棒性、效率和可解释性方面仍存在不足，亟需一种同时满足这三方面需求的检测方法。
AI.method: 提出CUPID方法，结合3D人脸重建的UV纹理图与掩码自编码器（MAE）的表征学习能力。训练阶段无需深度伪造视频或特定POI数据；测试阶段通过比对查询视频与参考视频的嵌入来评估真实性，并利用解码残差图在UV空间提供可解释性。
AI.result: 在四个深度伪造数据集上的实验表明，CUPID在大多数数据集上优于当前SOTA方法，在强下采样和压缩下具有最佳鲁棒性，且推理速度显著更快。
AI.conclusion: CUPID通过UV纹理图和MAE的结合，在无需深度伪造样本参与训练的条件下，实现了高效、鲁棒且可解释的POI深度伪造视频检测，为实际部署提供了有前景的方案。

title: Through the PRISM: Preference Representation in Intermediate States of Video Diffusion Models
summary: Evaluating video generation with clean, pixel-based reward models disconnects evaluation from the noisy diffusion process and incurs massive VAE decoding costs. In this paper, we challenge this paradigm by asking a fundamental question: Can a powerful video generator inherently discriminate preferences directly from noisy latents? To answer this, we introduce \textbf{PRISM} (\textbf{P}reference \textbf{R}epresentation in \textbf{I}ntermediate \textbf{S}tates of Diffusion \textbf{M}odels). PRISM employs a lightweight Query-based Aggregation head with a frozen video diffusion backbone to decode preference signals from noisy latents. Surprisingly, PRISM not only achieves SOTA preference accuracy but also unlocks strong noise-robustness, which enables early-stage Best-of-$N$ sampling. This allows for filtering suboptimal candidates at the very beginning of denoising, drastically reducing computation while boosting video quality. We also reveal a strong positive correlation between a backbone's generative performance and its inherent evaluative power, enabling self-improving video backbones.

AI.tldr: PRISM利用冻结的视频扩散骨干网络和轻量级查询聚合头，直接从噪声潜变量中解码偏好信号，实现了高精度、强噪声鲁棒性的视频评估，并支持早期Best-of-N采样以大幅降低计算开销。
AI.motivation: 传统视频评估依赖干净像素级奖励模型，与扩散过程的噪声特性脱节，且VAE解码成本高昂。作者质疑视频生成器本身能否直接从噪声潜变量中区分偏好，从而消除解码开销并提升效率。
AI.method: 提出PRISM框架，冻结视频扩散骨干网络，附加轻量级查询聚合头，直接从中间噪声潜变量中解码偏好信号，无需完整去噪过程或像素级重建。
AI.result: PRISM在偏好预测准确率上达到SOTA，同时具备强噪声鲁棒性；支持在去噪早期阶段进行Best-of-N采样，过滤次优候选，大幅减少计算量并提升生成质量；发现骨干网络的生成能力与其评估能力呈强正相关。
AI.conclusion: PRISM证明了视频生成器本身的潜变量空间即可有效编码偏好信息，实现了高效、鲁棒的视频评估，并揭示了生成与评估能力的协同关系，为自改进视频模型提供了新方向。

title: Reliability-Aware Prototype Calibration for Frozen Pose-Flow Video Anomaly Detection
comment: 15 pages, 5 figures, 7 tables. Code available at https://github.com/iNing10/RPC
summary: Pose-flow video anomaly detectors are attractive for one-class surveillance because they provide likelihood-based rankings for tracked skeleton windows. However, a single likelihood score may hide multimodal normal behavior and be sensitive to pose-observation noise. We study a frozen-detector setting in which the pose-flow backbone, cached skeleton tracks, and evaluation pipeline are fixed. Reliability-Aware Prototype Calibration (RPC) is a post-hoc score calibration method for this setting. It adds a standardized nearest-prototype deviation in the frozen latent space to the standardized flow score, and uses keypoint confidence only to gate this added geometric evidence. Thus, RPC preserves the original density signal while correcting the ranking with empirical normal-mode structure under pose reliability. Across two frozen pose-flow backbones and four datasets, RPC improves frame-level AUROC in all eight backbone-dataset pairs, with gains ranging from 0.34 to 4.49 percentage points and averaging 2.03 points. Ablation and reliability analyses show that prototype deviation is the main corrective signal, while reliability gating is most useful when pose observations are less trustworthy. These results suggest that lightweight post-hoc calibration can strengthen cached pose-flow systems when retraining or reproducing the full pose pipeline is impractical.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种轻量级的后处理校准方法RPC，通过结合潜在空间中的最近原型偏差和关键点置信度门控，提升了基于姿态流的视频异常检测器的性能，在8个实验中平均AUROC提升2.03个百分点。
AI.motivation: 现有的姿态流视频异常检测器仅依赖单一似然分数，无法捕捉多模态正常行为，且对姿态观测噪声敏感，亟需一种轻量级后处理方法进行校准。
AI.method: RPC在冻结的潜在空间中计算标准化最近原型偏差，与标准化的流分数结合，并利用关键点置信度门控来控制几何证据的加入，从而保留原始密度信号同时利用正常模态结构修正排序。
AI.result: 在8个骨干网络-数据集组合上，帧级AUROC提升0.34至4.49个百分点，平均提升2.03个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 轻量级后处理校准能够有效增强冻结的姿态流系统，在无法重新训练或复现完整姿态流水线时具有实用价值。

title: FlowBender: Feedback-Aware Training for Self-Correcting Conditional Flows
summary: Conditional diffusion and flow models routinely fail to satisfy the very constraints that define their task. For instance, a depth-conditioned model often produces images whose re-extracted depth disagrees with the input, even though the forward operator--the depth predictor defining the constraint--is available during both training and inference. Existing approaches generally fall into two categories: supervised models that treat the conditioning signal as a static cue and ignore alignment information at inference, and guidance-based methods that consult it through hand-tuned linear updates, typically trading fidelity to the condition against the plausibility of the generated sample. We argue that the fundamental gap in both paradigms is that the model is never trained to utilize its own alignment error. We introduce FlowBender, a closed-loop framework that treats this error as a first-class input, training the network to learn a correction policy conditioned on inference-time feedback. At each step, an unguided look-ahead pass estimates the clean signal, a task-specific deviation is computed via the forward operator, and a refinement pass consumes this signal to produce a corrected velocity. We propose several variants of FlowBender, including a gradient-based formulation for differentiable operators and a zero-order variant for non-differentiable settings such as JPEG compression. For efficient sampling, we introduce a prior-step shortcut that enables closed-loop correction at a minimal additional computational cost. Across image-to-image translation, restoration, and 3D mesh texturing, FlowBender consistently outperforms standard supervised baselines, alignment-loss-augmented training, and state-of-the-art inference-time guidance, improving fidelity and plausibility simultaneously rather than trading them against each other. Project page: https://flow-bender.github.io/

AI.tldr: FlowBender 是一个闭环框架，通过将对齐误差作为模型训练的一阶输入，在扩散和流模型中同时提升生成样本的保真度和合理性，解决了条件生成中约束无法满足的难题。
AI.motivation: 现有的条件扩散和流模型在生成过程中经常违反任务定义的约束（如深度条件模型生成图像的再提取深度与输入不一致）。传统监督方法忽略推理时的对齐信息，而引导方法通过手工调参的线性更新在保真度和合理性之间折衷。根本原因是模型从未被训练去利用自身的对齐误差。
AI.method: 提出 FlowBender 闭环框架：在每个采样步骤中，先进行无引导的"前瞻"传递估计干净信号，通过前向算子计算任务特定偏差，然后一个精炼传递消费该偏差信号以产生修正的 velocity。支持梯度版（适用于可微算子）和零阶版（适用于不可微场景如 JPEG 压缩）。还提出"前序捷径"技术以最小化额外计算成本。
AI.result: 在图像到图像翻译、图像恢复和 3D 网格纹理化任务上，FlowBender 一致优于标准监督基线、对齐损失增强训练以及最新的推理时引导方法，同时提升保真度和合理性，而非在两者之间折衷。
AI.conclusion: 将推理时的对齐误差作为训练信号是条件生成模型的关键改进方向，FlowBender 证明了闭环纠错范式可以有效打破保真度与合理性之间的权衡。

title: Spectral Query-Key Product Weight Steering for Training-Free VLM Hallucination Mitigation
summary: Vision-language models (VLMs) often generate fluent but visually unsupported descriptions, especially by mentioning objects absent from the image. We propose QK Product Steering, a data-free, training-free, and zero-inference-cost weight edit for reducing object hallucination. The method directly edits the per-head query-key product, the operator that produces pre-softmax attention logits, by suppressing a small number of dominant singular modes in selected middle layers. The edited product is then mapped back to the query weights through a closed-form query-only update while keeping shared key weights fixed, making the edit compatible with grouped-query attention. We further decompose the QK product into symmetric and antisymmetric components to distinguish mutual content-similarity patterns from directional attention patterns. Across three GQA-based VLMs, QK Product Steering achieves an average relative CHAIR$_s$ reduction of $4.0\%$, while matched random-mode controls show negligible change. Interpretability ablations show that the hallucination signal is specific to dominant QK modes and is primarily localized to the symmetric mutual-attention channel.
